notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 이해하신 부분도 있었지만, 제가 빈칸을 메운 부분도 있었습니다.
en: There were parts Mother understood, but there were also blanks I filled in.
ja: 母が理解した部分もありましたが、私が空白を埋めた部分もありました。
zh-CN: 母亲理解的部分也有，但也有我填补空白的部分。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 선은 제가 정해야 했는데 못 정했습니다. 도와드린다는 말로 계속 앞으로 밀었습니다.
en: I should have set the line, but I failed to do so. I kept pushing forward under the word “help.”
ja: 線は私が引くべきでしたが、引けませんでした。手伝うという言葉で前へ押し続けました。
zh-CN: 那条线本该由我划清，但我没有做到。我以“帮忙”为名继续往前推。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 최종 서류가 제 손을 거친 건 맞습니다. 다만 그걸 제 이익을 위한 숫자로만 보진 않았습니다.
en: It is true the final document passed through my hands. But I did not see those numbers only as something for my own benefit.
ja: 最終書類が私の手を経たのは事実です。ただ、その数字を私の利益のためだけのものとは見ていませんでした。
zh-CN: 最终文件经过我的手是真的。但我并没有只把那些数字看成是为了我自己的利益。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 최종 제출은 제 책임입니다. 다만 그 책임의 이유까지 돈으로만 묶을 수는 없습니다.
en: The final submission is my responsibility. But the reason for that responsibility cannot be tied only to money.
ja: 最終提出は私の責任です。ただ、その責任の理由まで金だけに結びつけることはできません。
zh-CN: 最终提交是我的责任。但这份责任的理由不能只和钱绑在一起。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 같은 날 문서가 달라진 사실을 모른 척할 수는 없습니다. 저는 그 변화를 가볍게 여기지 않았습니다.
en: I cannot pretend not to know that the document changed that day. I did not take that change lightly.
ja: 同じ日に文書が変わった事実を知らないふりはできません。私はその変化を軽く見ていませんでした。
zh-CN: 我不能假装不知道同一天文件发生了变化。我并没有轻看那个变化。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 다시 낸 서류에 제 판단이 들어간 건 인정합니다. 하지만 이유를 한 줄로 말하긴 어렵습니다.
en: I admit my judgment entered the document I resubmitted. But it is hard to explain the reason in one line.
ja: 出し直した書類に私の判断が入ったことは認めます。ですが、理由を一行で言うのは難しいです。
zh-CN: 我承认重新提交的文件里有我的判断。但理由很难用一句话说明。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 제출한 쪽이 마지막 문서였습니다. 그 사실 자체는 피하지 않겠습니다.
en: The document I submitted was the final one. I will not avoid that fact itself.
ja: 私が提出したものが最後の文書でした。その事実自体からは逃げません。
zh-CN: 我提交的是最后的文件。这个事实本身我不会回避。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 원래 비율을 그대로 두는 게 더 큰 다툼을 부를 거라고 봤습니다. 그래서 손을 댔습니다.
en: I thought leaving the original ratio as it was would cause a larger fight. So I touched it.
ja: 元の比率をそのままにすれば、もっと大きな争いを呼ぶと思いました。だから手を加えました。
zh-CN: 我觉得如果保留原来的比例，会引发更大的争执。所以我动了它。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제가 더 가지려고 낸 서류는 아닙니다. 그 정도는 분명히 말씀드리겠습니다.
en: Your Honor, the document I filed was not to take more for myself. That much I want to make clear.
ja: 裁判官、私が出した書類は、私がもっと取るためのものではありません。その点ははっきり申し上げます。
zh-CN: 法官，我提交那份文件不是为了让自己多拿。这一点我要明确说明。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 공증본을 다시 낸 사람은 저입니다. 다만 그 선택은 욕심보다 두려움에 가까웠습니다.
en: I am the one who resubmitted the notarized copy. But that choice was closer to fear than greed.
ja: 公証本を出し直したのは私です。ただ、その選択は欲よりも恐れに近いものでした。
zh-CN: 重新提交公证本的人是我。但那个选择比起贪心，更接近恐惧。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문서가 바뀐 흐름에서 제가 빠져 있었다고 말하진 않겠습니다. 하지만 계산은 단순하지 않았습니다.
en: I will not say I was absent from the flow in which the document changed. But the calculation was not simple.
ja: 文書が変わった流れに私がいなかったとは言いません。しかし、計算は単純ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我不会说自己不在文件变化的过程中。但其中的考虑并不简单。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 그 숫자가 형에게 어떤 폭발을 만들지 먼저 떠올렸습니다. 그래서 다시 냈습니다.
en: I first thought of what kind of explosion those numbers would create for my brother. That is why I resubmitted it.
ja: 私はまず、その数字が兄にどんな爆発を起こすかを考えました。だから出し直しました。
zh-CN: 我首先想到那些数字会让哥哥爆发成什么样。所以我重新提交了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 바꿨습니다. 어머니가 남긴 제 몫 90, 형 몫 10의 자필 연습본을 알고도 제 몫 60, 형 몫 40으로 낮춰 제출했습니다.
en: I changed it. Even knowing the handwritten draft gave me 90 and my brother 10, I submitted it reduced to 60 for me and 40 for him.
ja: 私が変えました。自筆下書きでは私の取り分が90、兄の取り分が10だと知りながら、私を60、兄を40に下げて提出しました。
zh-CN: 是我改的。我明知亲笔草稿写的是我90、哥哥10，却把它降成我60、哥哥40后提交了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈을 더 얻으려던 일은 아니었지만, 그래서 죄가 작아지는 건 아닙니다. 제가 고쳤습니다.
en: It was not done to get more money, but that does not make the offense smaller. I changed it.
ja: 金をもっと得るためではありませんでした。だからといって罪が小さくなるわけではありません。私が直しました。
zh-CN: 这不是为了多拿钱，但也不会因此让罪责变小。是我改了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 문서는 제 책임입니다. 더 받기 위해서가 아니라 형이 자필 연습본을 보지 않게 하려 고쳤습니다.
en: That document is my responsibility. I changed it not to receive more, but to keep my brother from seeing the handwritten draft.
ja: その文書は私の責任です。もっと受け取るためではなく、兄に自筆下書きを見せないために直しました。
zh-CN: 那份文件是我的责任。我修改它不是为了多拿，而是为了不让哥哥看到亲笔草稿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 제 손으로 잘라냈습니다. 형을 지킨다는 명분이 있었지만 위법한 선택이었습니다.
en: I cut down Mother's wishes with my own hands. I had the excuse of protecting my brother, but it was an unlawful choice.
ja: 私は母の意思を自分の手で切り落としました。兄を守るという名目はありましたが、違法な選択でした。
zh-CN: 我亲手削掉了母亲的意愿。虽然有保护哥哥的名义，但那是违法的选择。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 자필 연습본을 그대로 두면 제 출생과 관련한 민감한 가족사까지 열릴까 봐 두려웠습니다. 그래서 제 몫을 90에서 60으로 낮췄습니다.
en: Your Honor, I feared that if the handwritten draft remained as it was, a sensitive family matter tied to my birth would be opened as well. So I lowered my share from 90 to 60.
ja: 裁判官、自筆下書きをそのままにすれば、私の出生に関わる敏感な家族史まで開かれるのではないかと怖かったのです。だから私の取り分を90から60へ下げました。
zh-CN: 法官，我害怕如果亲笔草稿照原样留下，与我出生有关的敏感家事也会被打开。所以我把自己的份额从90降到了60。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 감당할 수 있는 숫자를 제가 정할 권리가 있다고 착각했습니다. 그래서 문서를 고쳤습니다.
en: I mistakenly thought I had the right to decide what numbers my brother could bear. That is why I altered the document.
ja: 兄が受け止められる数字を私が決める権利があると勘違いしました。だから文書を直しました。
zh-CN: 我误以为自己有权决定哥哥能承受什么数字。所以我改了文件。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제 몫을 줄였다는 사실이 책임을 없애진 않습니다. 어머니 뜻을 고친 사람은 저입니다.
en: The fact that I reduced my share does not erase responsibility. I am the one who changed Mother's wishes.
ja: 私の取り分を減らしたという事実は責任を消しません。母の意思を直したのは私です。
zh-CN: 我减少了自己的份额，这并不能消除责任。改动母亲意愿的人是我。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그날 마지막으로 서류를 낸 사람도, 자필 연습본을 막은 사람도 저였습니다. 변명하지 않겠습니다.
en: The person who filed the papers last that day was me, and the person who blocked the handwritten draft was also me. I will not make excuses.
ja: あの日最後に書類を出した人も、自筆下書きを止めた人も私でした。言い訳はしません。
zh-CN: 那天最后提交文件的人是我，挡住亲笔草稿的人也是我。我不辩解。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 덜 다치게 하려 했다는 말로는 부족합니다. 제가 어머니 뜻에 손댄 건 사실입니다.
en: Saying I tried to spare my brother is not enough. It is true I touched Mother's wishes.
ja: 兄を少しでも傷つけないようにしたという言葉では足りません。私が母の意思に手を加えたのは事実です。
zh-CN: 说我是想让哥哥少受伤，这还不够。事实是我动了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 제 몫 90, 형 몫 10인 자필 연습본의 이유가 드러나는 것을 막으려 제 몫 60, 형 몫 40이라는 거짓 안전선을 만들었습니다.
en: I created a false safety line of 60 for me and 40 for my brother to stop the reason for the handwritten draft—90 for me, 10 for him—from being exposed.
ja: 私は、私90・兄10という自筆下書きの理由が露わになるのを防ぐため、私60・兄40という偽の安全線を作りました。
zh-CN: 我为了阻止“我90、哥哥10”的亲笔草稿理由被揭开，制造了“我60、哥哥40”的虚假安全线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본에서는 제 몫이 훨씬 컸고, 공증본에서는 제가 제 몫을 낮췄습니다. 그 판단은 제가 했습니다. 형이 자필 연습본을 견디지 못할 거라 봤습니다.
en: In the handwritten draft my share was much larger, and in the notarized copy I lowered it. That judgment was mine. I thought my brother could not withstand the handwritten draft.
ja: 自筆下書きでは私の取り分がずっと大きく、公証本では私が自分の取り分を下げました。その判断は私がしました。兄は自筆下書きに耐えられないと思いました。
zh-CN: 亲笔草稿里我的份额大得多，而公证本里我降低了自己的份额。那个判断是我作的。我认为哥哥承受不了亲笔草稿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 공증 제출 전 제가 멈췄어야 했습니다. 하지만 자필 연습본의 이유가 열릴 뒤끝이 더 무서웠습니다.
en: I should have stopped before notarized submission. But I was more afraid of what would come after the reasons for the handwritten draft were opened.
ja: 公証提出の前に、私が止まるべきでした。けれど、自筆下書きの理由が開かれた後のことのほうが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 在提交公证前，我本该停下。但我更害怕亲笔草稿的理由被打开后的后果。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 다시 낸 서류는 제 몫을 줄인 서류였습니다. 더 받기 위한 손질은 아니었습니다.
en: The document I resubmitted reduced my own share. It was not an edit to receive more.
ja: 私が出し直した書類は、私の取り分を減らす書類でした。より多く受け取るための手直しではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我重新提交的文件是减少自己份额的文件。那不是为了多拿而做的改动。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본을 그대로 내면 형이 상속보다 이유를 먼저 물을 거라고 봤습니다. 그래서 제 몫을 낮추는 쪽으로 바꿨습니다.
en: If I submitted the handwritten draft as it was, I thought my brother would ask the reason before the inheritance itself. So I changed it in the direction of lowering my share.
ja: 自筆下書きをそのまま出せば、兄は相続より先に理由を尋ねると思いました。だから私の取り分を下げる方向に変えました。
zh-CN: 如果照原样提交亲笔草稿，我觉得哥哥会先问理由，而不是继承本身。所以我把它改成降低自己份额的方向。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 원래 숫자를 알면서도 낮췄습니다. 형이 모욕으로 받아들일 상황을 줄이려 했습니다.
en: I knew the original numbers and still lowered them. I was trying to reduce a situation my brother would take as an insult.
ja: 元の数字を知りながら下げました。兄が侮辱として受け取る状況を減らそうとしました。
zh-CN: 我明知道原来的数字，却还是降低了。我想减少哥哥会觉得被羞辱的情况。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 자필 연습본을 감췄습니다. 형이 그 비율의 이유까지 파고들까 두려웠습니다.
en: Your Honor, I hid the handwritten draft. I was afraid my brother would dig into the reason for that ratio.
ja: 裁判官、私は自筆下書きを隠しました。兄がその比率の理由まで掘り下げるのが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 法官，我隐藏了亲笔草稿。我害怕哥哥会追问那个比例的理由。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 변경은 우연이 아닙니다. 제가 형이 받아들일 만한 선이라고 멋대로 정했습니다.
en: That change was not accidental. I arbitrarily decided the line my brother could accept.
ja: その変更は偶然ではありません。私が、兄が受け入れられる線だと勝手に決めました。
zh-CN: 那个变更不是偶然。我擅自决定了哥哥可以接受的界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 몰라서 바꾼 게 아닙니다. 알고 있었기 때문에 오히려 위험하다고 생각했습니다.
en: I did not change it because I did not know Mother's wishes. I knew them, and that made me think they were dangerous.
ja: 母の意思を知らなかったから変えたのではありません。知っていたからこそ、むしろ危ないと思いました。
zh-CN: 我不是因为不知道母亲的意愿才改的。正因为知道，才反而觉得危险。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제 몫을 줄이면 다툼이 작아질 거라고 착각했습니다. 그 착각이 문서를 바꿨습니다.
en: I thought reducing my share would make the conflict smaller. That mistake changed the document.
ja: 私の取り分を減らせば争いが小さくなると勘違いしました。その勘違いが文書を変えました。
zh-CN: 我误以为减少自己的份额会让争执变小。这个误判改变了文件。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형의 분노를 예상했고, 그 분노를 숫자로 눌러 보려 했습니다. 지금은 그게 잘못임을 압니다.
en: I expected my brother's anger and tried to press that anger down with numbers. Now I know that was wrong.
ja: 兄の怒りを予想し、その怒りを数字で抑えようとしました。今はそれが間違いだったと分かります。
zh-CN: 我预料到哥哥会愤怒，想用数字压住那份愤怒。现在我知道那是错的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 막으려 한 건 형이 끝까지 파고드는 상황이었습니다. 그 끝이 어디로 갈지 저는 두려웠습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was my brother digging all the way in. I was afraid of where that would end.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは、兄が最後まで掘り下げる状況でした。その先がどこへ行くのか怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的是哥哥追问到底的情况。我害怕那会走到哪里。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 돈보다 설명을 막았습니다. 설명을 시작하면 멈출 수 없을 것 같았습니다.
en: I blocked the explanation, not the money. Once the explanation started, I thought it could not be stopped.
ja: 私が止めたのは金ではなく説明でした。説明を始めれば止められないと思いました。
zh-CN: 我挡住的不是钱，而是解释。我觉得解释一旦开始就停不下来。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈이 목적이었다면 제 몫을 낮추지 않았을 겁니다. 저는 다툼이 커지는 걸 막고 싶었습니다.
en: If money had been my goal, I would not have lowered my share. I wanted to stop the fight from growing.
ja: 金が目的なら、私の取り分を下げなかったはずです。争いが大きくなるのを止めたかったのです。
zh-CN: 如果目的是钱，我就不会降低自己的份额。我想阻止争执扩大。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본대로 가면 형은 비율에서 멈추지 않을 사람입니다. 그 다음 질문이 무서웠습니다.
en: If we followed the handwritten draft, my brother would not stop at the ratio. I was afraid of the next question.
ja: 自筆下書きどおりに進めば、兄は比率で止まらない人です。次の質問が怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 如果照亲笔草稿走，哥哥不会停在比例上。我害怕下一个问题。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 막으려 한 건 상속 싸움의 크기였습니다. 그 안에 더 깊은 사정이 얽혀 있었습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was the size of the inheritance fight. Deeper circumstances were tangled inside it.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは相続争いの大きさでした。その中にはもっと深い事情が絡んでいました。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的是继承争执的规模。里面还缠着更深的情况。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 이유를 묻기 시작하면 어머니 말년 전체가 법정에 올라올 것 같았습니다.
en: If my brother began asking why, Mother's entire final years would have been brought into court.
ja: 兄が理由を尋ね始めれば、母の晩年全体が法廷に上がると思いました。
zh-CN: 如果哥哥开始追问理由，母亲整个晚年都会被带上法庭。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 단순한 양보가 아니었습니다. 어떤 질문은 나오지 않게 해야 한다고 제가 판단했습니다.
en: It was not a simple concession. I decided that certain questions had to be kept from coming out.
ja: 単純な譲歩ではありませんでした。ある質問は出ないようにしなければならないと私が判断しました。
zh-CN: 那不是单纯的让步。我判断有些问题不能被问出来。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 형의 분노가 어머니에게까지 돌아갈까 봐 겁났습니다.
en: Your Honor, I was afraid my brother's anger would turn back toward Mother.
ja: 裁判官、兄の怒りが母にまで向くのではないかと怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 法官，我害怕哥哥的愤怒会转向母亲。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 숫자는 제게 안전장치처럼 보였습니다. 지금 생각하면 위험한 숨김이었습니다.
en: Those numbers looked to me like a safety device. Thinking now, they were a dangerous concealment.
ja: その数字は私には安全装置のように見えました。今思えば、危険な隠蔽でした。
zh-CN: 那些数字在我看来像安全装置。现在想来，那是危险的隐瞒。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본이 드러나면 형이 자신만 밀려났다고 느낄 거라 봤습니다. 그 반응을 막고 싶었습니다.
en: If the handwritten draft came out, I thought my brother would feel he alone had been pushed aside. I wanted to stop that reaction.
ja: 自筆下書きが出れば、兄は自分だけが押しのけられたと感じるだろうと思いました。その反応を止めたかったのです。
zh-CN: 如果亲笔草稿暴露，我以为哥哥会觉得只有自己被排除在外。我想阻止这种反应。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 막으려 한 건 형이 그 사실을 알게 되는 일이었습니다. 돈보다 그 충격이 두려웠습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was my brother learning that fact. I feared that shock more than money.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは、兄がその事実を知ることでした。金よりも、その衝撃が怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的是哥哥知道那个事实。比起钱，我更害怕那种冲击。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 막으려 했던 것은 결국 제 두려움이었습니다. 형이 무너질까 봐, 제가 진실을 전할 자신이 없었습니다.
en: What I tried to stop, in the end, was my own fear. I feared my brother would collapse, and I lacked the confidence to tell the truth.
ja: 結局、私が止めようとしたものは自分の恐れでした。兄が崩れるのが怖く、真実を伝える自信がありませんでした。
zh-CN: 归根到底，我想阻止的是自己的恐惧。我怕哥哥崩溃，也没有把真相告诉他的信心。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본대로 두면 형은 왜 자신이 그렇게 적은지 묻고, 결국 자기 출생까지 마주할 수밖에 없었습니다.
en: If the handwritten draft stood, my brother would ask why he had so little, and eventually he would have to face his own birth.
ja: 自筆下書きのままなら、兄はなぜ自分がそんなに少ないのかを尋ね、結局は自分の出生と向き合わざるを得なかったでしょう。
zh-CN: 如果亲笔草稿照原样存在，哥哥会问为什么自己那么少，最终也不得不面对自己的出生问题。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 오래 얽힌 돈과 어머니 일기, 제 출생과 관련한 민감한 사실이 한꺼번에 터질까 봐 제 몫을 90에서 60으로 낮췄습니다.
en: I lowered my share from 90 to 60 because I feared the long-entangled money, Mother's diary, and a sensitive fact tied to my birth would all burst out at once.
ja: 長く絡んだ金、母の日記、私の出生に関わる敏感な事実が一度に噴き出すのではないかと怖くて、私の取り分を90から60へ下げました。
zh-CN: 我把自己的份额从90降到60，是因为害怕长期纠缠的钱、母亲日记以及与我出生有关的敏感事实会一次爆开。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 지키겠다는 명분으로 진실을 막았습니다. 그 과정에서 어머니 뜻도 제 손으로 막았습니다.
en: In the name of protecting my brother, I blocked the truth. In that process, I also blocked Mother's wishes with my own hands.
ja: 兄を守るという名目で、真実を塞ぎました。その過程で、母の意思も私の手で塞ぎました。
zh-CN: 我以保护哥哥为名挡住了真相。在这个过程中，我也亲手挡住了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 돈을 지키려 한 게 아니라 형이 무너지는 장면을 피하려 한 겁니다. 그래도 위조는 위조입니다.
en: Your Honor, I was not trying to protect money; I was trying to avoid the sight of my brother collapsing. Still, forgery is forgery.
ja: 裁判官、金を守ろうとしたのではなく、兄が崩れる場面を避けようとしたのです。それでも、偽造は偽造です。
zh-CN: 法官，我不是想守住钱，而是想避开哥哥崩溃的场面。即便如此，伪造就是伪造。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 막은 건 상속 다툼이 아니라 형의 삶 전체를 흔들 사실이었습니다. 그 판단을 제가 할 권리는 없었습니다.
en: What I blocked was not an inheritance dispute but a fact that could shake my brother's whole life. I had no right to make that judgment.
ja: 私が止めたのは相続争いではなく、兄の人生全体を揺るがす事実でした。その判断を私がする権利はありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我挡住的不是继承争执，而是可能动摇哥哥整个人生的事实。我没有权利替他作这个判断。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게 덜 아픈 숫자를 골라 주겠다는 생각 자체가 오만했습니다. 그래서 이 자리까지 왔습니다.
en: The very idea that I would choose less painful numbers for my brother was arrogant. That is why we came this far.
ja: 兄にとって痛みの少ない数字を選んでやるという考え自体が傲慢でした。だからここまで来ました。
zh-CN: 认为自己可以替哥哥选择没那么痛的数字，这个想法本身就是傲慢。所以才走到这里。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 법정까지 오지 않게 하려 했다는 말은 맞습니다. 하지만 그 말이 문서를 고친 책임을 지우지는 못합니다.
en: It is true I tried to keep the matter from coming to court. But those words cannot erase my responsibility for changing the document.
ja: 法廷まで来ないようにしようとしたという言葉は事実です。しかし、その言葉が文書を直した責任を消すことはできません。
zh-CN: 说我想避免走到法庭，这是事实。但这句话不能抹去我修改文件的责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형을 진실에서 떼어 놓으려 했고, 어머니의 마지막 뜻도 함께 떼어 냈습니다.
en: I tried to keep my brother away from the truth, and I took away Mother's final wishes with it.
ja: 私は兄を真実から遠ざけようとし、母の最後の意思も一緒に切り離しました。
zh-CN: 我试图把哥哥和真相隔开，也一并割离了母亲最后的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 막으려 한 건 자필 연습본 비율의 이유였습니다. 형이 그걸 묻기 시작하면 제가 오래 숨긴 돈도 같이 열릴 수 있었습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was the reason behind the handwritten draft's ratio. If my brother began asking about that, the money I had long hidden could also come out.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは、自筆下書きの比率の理由でした。兄がそれを尋ね始めれば、私が長く隠してきた金も一緒に開かれる可能性がありました。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的是亲笔草稿比例背后的理由。哥哥一旦开始追问，我长期隐藏的钱也可能一起被打开。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 막으려 한 건 형의 분노와 그 뒤의 질문이었습니다. 책임은 그때부터 이미 생겼습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was my brother's anger and the questions after it. Responsibility had already begun there.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは兄の怒りと、その後の質問でした。責任はその時からすでに生じていました。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的是哥哥的愤怒，以及愤怒之后的问题。责任从那时起就已经产生了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 왜 어머니가 제 쪽으로 그렇게 크게 기울었는지 묻게 될까 봐 두려웠습니다.
en: I feared my brother would ask why Mother had leaned so heavily toward me.
ja: 兄が、なぜ母が私の側へそこまで大きく傾いたのかを尋ねるのが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我害怕哥哥会问，为什么母亲会那么明显地倾向我这一边。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈이 아니라 질문을 막으려 했습니다. 그 질문은 어머니 기록과 제가 도운 돈으로 이어질 수밖에 없었습니다.
en: I was trying to block the question, not the money. That question would inevitably lead to Mother's records and the money I had provided.
ja: 止めようとしたのは金ではなく質問でした。その質問は、母の記録と私が支援した金へつながるしかなかったからです。
zh-CN: 我想挡住的不是钱，而是问题。那个问题必然会通向母亲的记录和我提供的钱。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 최종본은 형의 분노를 잠깐 늦추려는 제멋대로의 장치였습니다. 정당한 방법은 아니었습니다.
en: The final copy was my arbitrary device to delay my brother's anger for a while. It was not a lawful method.
ja: 最終本は、兄の怒りをしばらく遅らせようとする私の身勝手な装置でした。正当な方法ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 最终本是我擅自用来暂时延缓哥哥愤怒的装置。那不是正当方法。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 자필 연습본을 보면 자신이 버려졌다고 느낄 겁니다. 저는 그 감정이 더 깊은 사실로 번지는 걸 막으려 했습니다.
en: If my brother saw the handwritten draft, he would feel abandoned. I tried to stop that feeling from spreading into deeper facts.
ja: 兄が自筆下書きを見れば、自分が捨てられたと感じるでしょう。私はその感情がさらに深い事実へ広がるのを止めようとしました。
zh-CN: 哥哥如果看到亲笔草稿，会觉得自己被抛弃。我试图阻止这种情绪扩散到更深的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 남긴 이유를 설명하려면 제가 감춘 돈까지 말해야 했습니다. 그걸 피하려 숫자를 고쳤습니다.
en: To explain why Mother left the handwritten draft, I would have had to speak about the money I had hidden. I altered the numbers to avoid that.
ja: 母がその理由を残したことを説明するには、私が隠していた金まで話さなければなりませんでした。それを避けるために数字を変えました。
zh-CN: 要解释母亲留下那个理由，就必须说到我隐藏的钱。我为了避开这一点才改了数字。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 법정까지 오지 않게 하려고 했습니다. 그 과정에서 법을 어겼습니다.
en: Your Honor, I tried to keep it from coming to court. In the process, I broke the law.
ja: 裁判官、私は法廷まで来ないようにしようとしました。その過程で法を犯しました。
zh-CN: 法官，我试图不让事情走到法庭。在这个过程中，我违法了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 달래려 했다고 말할 수 있지만, 사실은 형에게 필요한 설명을 막은 겁니다.
en: I can say I tried to calm my brother, but in truth I blocked the explanation he needed.
ja: 兄をなだめようとしたと言うことはできます。しかし実際には、兄に必要な説明を止めたのです。
zh-CN: 我可以说自己是想安抚哥哥。但事实上，我挡住了他所需要的说明。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본을 막으면 모두가 덜 다칠 거라고 믿었습니다. 그 믿음이 어머니 뜻을 다시 훼손했습니다.
en: I believed that blocking the handwritten draft would hurt everyone less. That belief damaged Mother's wishes again.
ja: 自筆下書きを止めれば皆が少しは傷つかずに済むと信じました。その信念が母の意思を再び傷つけました。
zh-CN: 我相信挡住亲笔草稿能让所有人少受伤。这个信念再次伤害了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제 돈이 어머니 쪽으로 들어간 건 맞습니다. 그 돈이 집안에 쓰인 것도 알고 있었습니다.
en: It is true my money went through Mother's side. I also knew that money was used for the household.
ja: 私の金が母のほうへ入ったのは事実です。その金が家のために使われたことも知っていました。
zh-CN: 我的钱确实进了母亲那边。我也知道那些钱被用于家里。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 도움이 있었다는 건 인정합니다. 다만 그걸 형에게 빚처럼 남기고 싶지 않았습니다.
en: I admit there was help. But I did not want it to remain to my brother like a debt.
ja: 支援があったことは認めます。ただ、それを兄への借りのように残したくありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我承认有过帮助。但我不想让它以债的形式留给哥哥。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그렇게 이어진 정황을 완전히 모른 척할 수는 없습니다. 다만 규모를 내세우고 싶지는 않았습니다.
en: I cannot completely pretend not to know the circumstances that continued that way. I simply did not want to put the scale forward.
ja: そのように続いた事情を完全に知らないふりはできません。ただ、規模を前に出したくはありませんでした。
zh-CN: 那样持续下来的情况，我不能完全装作不知道。只是我不想强调规模。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 보낸 돈이 형 쪽 필요로 흘러간 적이 있습니다. 그걸 거래처럼 말하고 싶지 않았습니다.
en: There were times when money I sent flowed to my brother's needs. I did not want to speak of it like a transaction.
ja: 私が送った金が兄の必要へ流れたことがあります。それを取引のように話したくありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我送的钱有时流向了哥哥的需要。我不想把它说得像交易一样。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 통장을 거친 돈 중 제 몫이 섞인 건 사실입니다. 형에게 말하지 않았을 뿐입니다.
en: It is true that some of the money through Mother's account included my share. I just did not tell my brother.
ja: 母の通帳を経た金の中に私の分が混じっていたのは事実です。兄に言わなかっただけです。
zh-CN: 经过母亲账户的钱里混有我的部分，这是事实。只是我没有告诉哥哥。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈의 출처가 단순히 어머니만은 아니었습니다. 그 정도는 이제 말씀드릴 수 있습니다.
en: The source of the money was not simply Mother. That much I can now tell you.
ja: 金の出所は単純に母だけではありませんでした。その程度は今申し上げられます。
zh-CN: 钱的来源并不只是母亲。至少这一点我现在可以说。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제가 도운 부분은 있습니다. 하지만 그걸 자랑처럼 세우고 싶지는 않았습니다.
en: Your Honor, there were parts where I helped. But I did not want to set that up like a boast.
ja: 裁判官、私が助けた部分はあります。しかし、それを自慢のように立てたくはありませんでした。
zh-CN: 法官，我确实有帮忙的部分。但我不想把它摆出来像是在炫耀。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 알면 고마움보다 모욕으로 받을까 봐 계속 덮었습니다.
en: I kept covering it up because I feared my brother would take it as humiliation rather than gratitude.
ja: 兄が知れば感謝より屈辱として受け取るのではないかと思い、ずっと覆っていました。
zh-CN: 我一直遮掩，是怕哥哥知道后感到的不是感激，而是羞辱。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 공장 쪽으로 간 돈도 일부는 제 쪽에서 시작됐습니다. 그 사실을 오래 숨겼습니다.
en: Some of the money that went to the factory also began on my side. I hid that fact for a long time.
ja: 工場のほうへ行った金の一部も、私の側から始まりました。その事実を長く隠しました。
zh-CN: 流向工厂的钱也有一部分从我这边开始。我把这个事实藏了很久。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 돈을 제 이름으로 남기지 않은 건 의도적이었습니다. 형을 자극하고 싶지 않았습니다.
en: Leaving that money out of my name was intentional. I did not want to provoke my brother.
ja: その金を私の名前で残さなかったのは意図的でした。兄を刺激したくありませんでした。
zh-CN: 没有用我的名义留下那笔钱，是有意的。我不想刺激哥哥。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 20년 넘게 매달 보냈고, 형 공장 위기 때 큰돈도 제가 메웠습니다. 형은 그걸 어머니 돈으로 알았습니다.
en: For more than twenty years I sent money every month, and when my brother's factory was in crisis, I covered a large amount as well. My brother believed it was Mother's money.
ja: 20年以上、毎月送り、兄の工場が危機の時には大きな金も私が補いました。兄はそれを母の金だと思っていました。
zh-CN: 二十多年里我每月汇钱，哥哥工厂遇到危机时，大笔资金也是我补上的。哥哥以为那是母亲的钱。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 정기 지원금과 사업장 자금의 상당 부분이 제 돈이었다는 점, 이제는 더 숨기지 않겠습니다.
en: I will no longer hide that a substantial part of the regular support and business funds was my money.
ja: 定期支援金と事業場資金の相当部分が私の金だったことを、もう隠しません。
zh-CN: 定期支援金和事业资金中相当一部分是我的钱，这一点我不会再隐藏。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 정기 지원금과 사업장 자금 상당수는 제 돈이었습니다. 저는 그 사실을 숨기도록 구조를 만들었습니다.
en: Your Honor, much of the regular support and business funds was my money. I built the structure that hid that fact.
ja: 裁判官、定期支援金と事業場資金の多くは私の金でした。私はその事実を隠す仕組みを作りました。
zh-CN: 法官，定期支援金和事业资金中很多都是我的钱。我制造了隐藏这一事实的结构。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 보낸 돈이 어머니 계좌를 거쳐 형에게 갔습니다. 우연이 아니라 제가 택한 방식이었습니다.
en: The money I sent went through Mother's account to my brother. It was not by chance; it was the method I chose.
ja: 私が送った金は、母の口座を通って兄へ行きました。偶然ではなく、私が選んだ方法でした。
zh-CN: 我汇出的钱经过母亲的账户到了哥哥那里。这不是偶然，而是我选择的方式。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 동생 돈으로 버텼다는 사실을 모르게 하려고, 어머니 이름을 앞에 세웠습니다.
en: I put Mother's name in front so my brother would not know he had been getting by on his younger brother's money.
ja: 兄が弟の金で持ちこたえていたと知らないように、母の名前を前に立てました。
zh-CN: 为了不让哥哥知道自己是靠弟弟的钱撑过来的，我把母亲的名字放在了前面。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 도움은 한두 번에 그치지 않았습니다. 오랜 시간 형의 생활과 공장을 받친 흐름이었습니다.
en: That help did not happen only once or twice. It was a flow that supported my brother's life and factory for a long time.
ja: その支援は一度や二度ではありません。長い間、兄の生活と工場を支えた流れでした。
zh-CN: 那份帮助不是一两次。它是长期支撑哥哥生活和工厂的一股资金流。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 알면 자존심보다 정체성이 먼저 흔들릴 거라 봤습니다. 그래서 끝까지 숨겼습니다.
en: I thought that if my brother knew, his identity would shake before his pride. So I hid it until the end.
ja: 兄が知れば、誇りより先に自分の立場が揺らぐと思いました。だから最後まで隠しました。
zh-CN: 我认为哥哥如果知道，先动摇的不是自尊，而是他的身份认同。所以我一直藏到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈을 보낸 사람도 저이고, 그 돈의 출처를 흐린 사람도 저입니다. 그 책임을 인정합니다.
en: I am the one who sent the money, and I am also the one who blurred where it came from. I admit that responsibility.
ja: 金を送ったのも私で、その金の出所を曖昧にしたのも私です。その責任を認めます。
zh-CN: 汇钱的人是我，把钱的来源弄模糊的人也是我。我承认这个责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 도운 것처럼 보인 많은 돈의 뒤에 제가 있었습니다. 형은 그걸 알 기회가 없었습니다.
en: Behind much of the money that looked like Mother's help, I was there. My brother had no chance to know that.
ja: 母が助けたように見えた多くの金の後ろに、私がいました。兄にはそれを知る機会がありませんでした。
zh-CN: 许多看起来像母亲帮助的钱背后，其实有我在。哥哥没有机会知道这一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 선의라고 믿었지만, 형이 진실을 알 권리까지 제가 막은 셈입니다.
en: I believed it was goodwill, but it also meant I blocked my brother's right to know the truth.
ja: 私は善意だと信じていましたが、兄が真実を知る権利まで私が塞いだことになります。
zh-CN: 我相信那是善意，但这也等于我挡住了哥哥知道真相的权利。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 정기 지원금을 보냈고, 형 사업장 자금에도 제 돈이 섞였습니다. 어머니 이름으로 보이게 했습니다.
en: I sent regular support for a long time, and my money was mixed into my brother's business funds as well. I made it look like Mother's name.
ja: 長く定期支援金を送り、兄の事業場資金にも私の金が混じりました。母の名前で見えるようにしました。
zh-CN: 我长期汇出定期支援金，哥哥的事业资金里也混有我的钱。我让它看起来像是母亲的名义。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 보낸 돈이 형을 받친 건 맞습니다. 다만 그 사실을 감춘 이유가 더 중요했습니다.
en: It is true the money I sent supported my brother. But the reason I hid that fact mattered more.
ja: 私が送った金が兄を支えたのは事実です。ただ、その事実を隠した理由のほうが重要でした。
zh-CN: 我送的钱支撑了哥哥，这是事实。但我隐藏这个事实的理由更重要。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상당수는 제 돈이었습니다. 형이 어머니가 돕는다고 믿도록 제가 그 구조를 그대로 뒀습니다.
en: A substantial part was my money. I left the structure as it was so my brother could believe Mother was helping him.
ja: かなりの部分は私の金でした。兄が母に助けられていると信じられるよう、その構造をそのままにしました。
zh-CN: 相当一部分是我的钱。我让这个结构维持下去，让哥哥相信是母亲在帮助他。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 받아들이지 않을 걸 알고 설명을 미뤘습니다. 그래서 돈 문제를 혼자 안고 가려 했습니다.
en: I knew my brother would not accept it, so I put off explaining. I tried to carry the money issue alone.
ja: 兄が受け入れないと分かっていて説明を先延ばしにしました。金の問題を一人で抱えていこうとしました。
zh-CN: 我知道哥哥不会接受，所以推迟说明。我想一个人承担钱的问题。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 버틴 돈 중에는 제가 보낸 돈이 있었습니다. 저는 그 사실을 일부러 말하지 않았습니다.
en: Among the money my brother lived on, some was money I sent. I deliberately did not tell him.
ja: 兄が持ちこたえた金の中には、私が送った金がありました。私はその事実をわざと言いませんでした。
zh-CN: 哥哥撑下来的钱里有我汇出的部分。我是故意没有告诉他。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 통장을 통로로 둔 건 형의 체면 때문이었습니다. 직접 받으면 못 견딜 거라 봤습니다.
en: I used Mother's account as the passage because of my brother's pride. I thought he could not bear receiving it directly.
ja: 母の通帳を通路にしたのは、兄の体面のためでした。直接受け取れば耐えられないと思いました。
zh-CN: 我把母亲的账户作为通道，是为了哥哥的体面。我觉得他无法承受直接接受我的钱。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 돈의 방향을 알고도 계속 보냈습니다. 형이 모르게 하는 게 더 낫다고 믿었습니다.
en: I knew the direction of that money and kept sending it. I believed it was better that my brother not know.
ja: その金の方向を知りながら、送り続けました。兄が知らないほうがいいと信じていました。
zh-CN: 我明知那笔钱的流向，还是继续汇。我相信哥哥不知道会比较好。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 정기 지원금만이 아니라 공장 위기 때 들어간 큰돈도 제 쪽에서 나간 적이 있습니다.
en: It was not only regular support; large sums sent during the factory crisis also came from my side at times.
ja: 定期支援金だけではなく、工場危機の時に入った大きな金も、私の側から出たことがあります。
zh-CN: 不只是定期支援金，工厂危机时流入的大笔资金也有从我这边出去的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 그 돈을 드러내면 형이 도움보다 굴욕을 먼저 느낄 거라고 생각했습니다.
en: I thought if I revealed that money, my brother would feel humiliation before help.
ja: その金を明らかにすれば、兄は支援より屈辱を先に感じると思いました。
zh-CN: 我认为如果把那笔钱说出来，哥哥先感到的会是屈辱，而不是帮助。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 모르던 도움이 꽤 오래 이어졌습니다. 그걸 어머니 도움처럼 남겨 둔 사람은 저입니다.
en: Help my brother did not know about continued for quite a long time. I am the one who left it looking like Mother's help.
ja: 兄が知らなかった支援はかなり長く続きました。それを母の支援のように残したのは私です。
zh-CN: 哥哥不知道的帮助持续了很久。让它看起来像母亲帮助的人是我。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게 말하면 도움보다 모욕으로 남을 것 같았습니다. 그래서 어머니 이름 뒤에 숨겼습니다.
en: If I told my brother, I thought it would remain as humiliation rather than help. So I hid behind Mother's name.
ja: 兄に言えば、支援よりも屈辱として残ると思いました。だから母の名前の後ろに隠しました。
zh-CN: 如果告诉哥哥，我觉得那会留下的不是帮助，而是羞辱。所以我躲在母亲的名字后面。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 침묵이 오래 갈수록 말할 수 없게 됐습니다. 처음부터 잘못된 숨김이었습니다.
en: The longer that silence lasted, the harder it became to speak. It was a wrong concealment from the start.
ja: その沈黙が長引くほど、言えなくなりました。最初から誤った隠し方でした。
zh-CN: 沉默拖得越久，就越说不出口。从一开始，这就是错误的隐瞒。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형은 체면을 먼저 보는 사람입니다. 제 돈이라고 알면 받지 않았을 겁니다.
en: My brother is someone who puts pride first. If he knew it was my money, he would not have accepted it.
ja: 兄は体面を先に見る人です。私の金だと知れば受け取らなかったでしょう。
zh-CN: 哥哥是先看体面的人。如果知道是我的钱，他不会接受。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말하지 않은 건 우위를 잡으려는 뜻이 아니었습니다. 형이 상처받을까 봐 피했습니다.
en: Not telling him was not meant to gain the upper hand. I avoided it because I thought he would be hurt.
ja: 言わなかったのは優位に立つためではありませんでした。兄が傷つくと思って避けました。
zh-CN: 我不说，并不是想占上风。而是怕哥哥受伤，所以回避了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 돈이 형에게 빚처럼 느껴지지 않길 바랐습니다. 그래서 출처를 흐렸습니다.
en: I hoped that money would not feel like a debt to him. So I blurred its source.
ja: その金が兄に借りのように感じられないことを望みました。だから出所を曖昧にしました。
zh-CN: 我希望那笔钱对哥哥来说不要像债。所以我模糊了来源。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 도와준 모양이면 형이 조금은 편하게 받을 수 있다고 생각했습니다.
en: I thought if it looked like Mother's help, my brother could accept it a little more easily.
ja: 母が助けた形なら、兄が少しは楽に受け取れると思いました。
zh-CN: 我觉得如果看起来是母亲帮的，哥哥会稍微更容易接受。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 형 자존심을 먼저 생각했습니다. 그 판단이 옳았는지는 모르겠습니다.
en: Your Honor, I thought of my brother's pride first. I do not know whether that judgment was right.
ja: 裁判官、私は兄の自尊心を先に考えました。その判断が正しかったかは分かりません。
zh-CN: 法官，我首先考虑的是哥哥的自尊。那个判断是否正确，我不知道。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게 직접 말하는 순간 관계가 더 멀어질 것 같았습니다.
en: The moment I told my brother directly, I thought our relationship would grow more distant.
ja: 兄に直接話した瞬間、関係がさらに遠ざかると思いました。
zh-CN: 我觉得只要直接告诉哥哥，关系就会变得更远。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고마워하라는 뜻으로 보낸 돈이 아니어서 더 말하지 않았습니다.
en: I did not send the money to make him grateful, so I said even less.
ja: 感謝しろという意味で送った金ではなかったので、なおさら言いませんでした。
zh-CN: 我汇钱不是为了让他感激，所以更没有说。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 먼저 말하지 않은 돈 문제가 있습니다. 아직 그 선택을 어떻게 설명해야 할지 모르겠습니다.
en: There is a money issue I did not speak of first. I still do not know how to explain that choice.
ja: 私が先に話さなかった金の問題があります。その選択をどう説明すべきか、まだ分かりません。
zh-CN: 有一件钱的问题，是我没有先说出来的。我还不知道该如何解释这个选择。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 어머니 사랑으로 믿은 돈이 사실 제 돈이라는 걸 알면, 지난 삶 전체를 의심할까 두려웠습니다.
en: I was afraid that if my brother learned the money he believed was Mother's love was actually mine, he would doubt his entire past life.
ja: 兄が母の愛だと信じていた金が実は私の金だと知れば、これまでの人生全体を疑うのではないかと怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我害怕哥哥如果知道他以为是母亲爱意的钱其实是我的，会开始怀疑自己过去的一整段人生。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 이제 인정합니다. 형의 자존심을 지킨다는 말로 형의 진실을 제가 오래 미뤘습니다.
en: I admit it now. In the name of protecting my brother's pride, I postponed his truth for a long time.
ja: 今は認めます。兄の自尊心を守るという言葉で、兄の真実を長く先送りしました。
zh-CN: 现在我承认。我用保护哥哥自尊的说法，把属于他的真相拖延了很久。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 형의 자존심이 아니라 정체성이 무너질까 봐 말하지 못했습니다.
en: Your Honor, I could not speak not because of my brother's pride, but because I feared his identity would collapse.
ja: 裁判官、私は兄の自尊心ではなく、兄のアイデンティティが崩れるのではないかと怖くて言えませんでした。
zh-CN: 法官，我说不出口，不是因为哥哥的自尊，而是害怕他的身份认同会崩塌。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈의 출처를 밝히면 곧 그 사실의 이유까지 이어질 수 있었습니다. 그래서 더 숨겼습니다.
en: If I revealed the source of the money, it could lead straight to the reason behind that fact. So I hid it even more.
ja: 金の出所を明かせば、その事実の理由にまでつながりかねませんでした。だからさらに隠しました。
zh-CN: 如果揭开钱的来源，就会连到这个事实背后的原因。所以我更加隐瞒。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 받은 도움을 사랑이 아니라 속임수로 느낄까 봐 겁났습니다. 그렇게 두려워하다가 20년 동안 말하지 못했습니다.
en: I feared my brother would feel the help he received was deception, not love. Out of that fear, I could not speak for twenty years.
ja: 兄が受けた支援を愛ではなく欺きだと感じるのではないかと怖かったのです。その恐れのまま、20年間言えませんでした。
zh-CN: 我害怕哥哥会把自己得到的帮助感受成欺骗，而不是爱。因为这种恐惧，我二十年都没能说出口。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 말은 맞지만, 형에게 진실을 고를 권리를 빼앗은 것도 맞습니다.
en: It is true that I tried to avoid the other side knowing, but it is also true that I took away my brother's right to choose the truth.
ja: 相手に知られるのを避けようとしたという言葉は正しいですが、兄が真実を選ぶ権利を奪ったのも正しいです。
zh-CN: 我确实试图避免对方知道，但我也确实夺走了哥哥选择真相的权利。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 이름으로 감춘 돈은 형을 보호한다는 명분이었고 동시에 제 비겁함이었습니다.
en: The money hidden under Mother's name was my excuse of protecting my brother, and at the same time my cowardice.
ja: 母の名前で隠した金は、兄を守るという名目であり、同時に私の臆病さでした。
zh-CN: 用母亲名义隐藏的钱，是我保护哥哥的名义，也同时是我的怯懦。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 동생 돈으로 버텼다는 사실을 견디지 못할 거라 단정했습니다. 그 단정이 잘못이었습니다.
en: I decided that my brother could not bear the fact that he had relied on his younger brother's money. That decision was wrong.
ja: 兄が弟の金で持ちこたえたという事実に耐えられないと、私が決めつけました。その決めつけが間違っていました。
zh-CN: 我断定哥哥无法承受自己靠弟弟的钱撑下来的事实。这个断定是错的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 평생 믿은 기반이 흔들릴까 봐 제가 대신 숨겼습니다. 그 대신 숨길 권리는 제게 없었습니다.
en: I hid it in his place because I feared the foundation he had believed in all his life would shake. I had no right to hide it for him.
ja: 兄が一生信じてきた基盤が揺らぐのではないかと思い、私が代わりに隠しました。代わりに隠す権利は私にはありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我担心哥哥一生相信的基础会动摇，所以替他隐瞒。但我没有替他隐瞒的权利。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 20년 동안 말하지 않은 이유는 결국 두려움입니다. 형이 저를 미워하는 것보다 자신을 잃을까 봐 두려웠습니다.
en: The reason I did not speak for twenty years was fear. I was more afraid he would lose himself than that he would hate me.
ja: 20年間言わなかった理由は、結局は恐れです。兄が私を憎むことより、自分を失うことのほうが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 二十年没说的理由，归根到底是恐惧。比起哥哥恨我，我更怕他失去自己。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 장남으로 버틴 자리를 제가 깨고 싶지 않았습니다. 그래서 제가 보낸 돈을 어머니 도움처럼 남겼습니다.
en: I did not want to break the place my brother had held as eldest son. So I left the money I sent looking like Mother's help.
ja: 兄が長男として支えてきた場所を私が壊したくありませんでした。だから私が送った金を母の支援のように残しました。
zh-CN: 我不想打破哥哥作为长子支撑下来的位置。所以我把自己汇的钱留成像母亲的帮助。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말하지 않은 이유는 형을 낮추고 싶지 않았기 때문입니다. 그 마음이 진실을 늦췄습니다.
en: I did not speak because I did not want to lower my brother. That feeling delayed the truth.
ja: 言わなかった理由は、兄を低く見せたくなかったからです。その気持ちが真実を遅らせました。
zh-CN: 我不说，是因为不想让哥哥显得低人一等。这个心情拖延了真相。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 보냈다고 말하면 형은 고마움보다 수치심을 느꼈을 겁니다. 그걸 피하려 했습니다.
en: If I said I sent it, my brother would have felt shame before gratitude. I tried to avoid that.
ja: 私が送ったと言えば、兄は感謝より恥を感じたでしょう。それを避けようとしました。
zh-CN: 如果说是我汇的，哥哥先感到的会是羞耻，而不是感激。我想避开这一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니도 형이 제 돈을 직접 받는 모양을 힘들어할 걸 아셨습니다. 그래서 조용히 둔 겁니다.
en: Mother also knew my brother would struggle with receiving my money directly. So we left it quiet.
ja: 母も、兄が私の金を直接受け取る形をつらく思うと知っていました。だから静かにしておいたのです。
zh-CN: 母亲也知道哥哥会难以接受直接拿我的钱。所以我们就安静地放着。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 자존심을 지킨다는 말로 제 침묵을 합리화했습니다. 지금은 그 말도 완전하지 않다는 걸 압니다.
en: I rationalized my silence by saying I was protecting my brother's pride. Now I know that statement is not complete either.
ja: 兄の自尊心を守るという言葉で、自分の沈黙を合理化しました。今はその言葉も完全ではないと分かります。
zh-CN: 我用保护哥哥自尊这句话合理化自己的沉默。现在我知道，这句话也不完整。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게는 어머니가 돕는다는 믿음이 버팀목이었습니다. 제가 그 믿음을 일부러 건드리지 않았습니다.
en: For my brother, the belief that Mother was helping him was a support. I deliberately did not touch that belief.
ja: 兄にとって、母が助けてくれているという信念は支えでした。私はその信念をわざと触りませんでした。
zh-CN: 对哥哥来说，母亲在帮助自己的信念是一种支柱。我故意没有碰那个信念。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돈의 출처를 말하려면 형이 살아온 장남의 자리까지 흔들릴 수 있다고 봤습니다.
en: To speak of the source of the money, I thought, could shake the eldest-son position my brother had lived in.
ja: 金の出所を話すには、兄が生きてきた長男の場所まで揺らぎかねないと思いました。
zh-CN: 我认为一旦说出钱的来源，连哥哥一直以来作为长子的立足点都会动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 체면을 지켜준다고 생각했지만 결국 형을 모른 채 두었습니다.
en: Your Honor, I thought I was preserving his pride, but in the end I left my brother ignorant.
ja: 裁判官、私は体面を守っていると思いましたが、結局は兄を知らないままにしました。
zh-CN: 法官，我以为自己是在维护体面，但最后只是让哥哥一直不知道。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 동생에게 의지했다는 사실을 받아들이기 어렵다고 봤습니다. 그래서 계속 숨겼습니다.
en: I thought my brother would find it hard to accept that he had relied on his younger brother. So I kept hiding it.
ja: 兄が弟に頼っていた事実を受け入れにくいと思いました。だから隠し続けました。
zh-CN: 我觉得哥哥很难接受自己依靠了弟弟。所以我一直隐瞒。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
