en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 가족을 도운 것이라고 믿고 싶었습니다. 하지만 숨긴 대가는 형이 치렀습니다.
en: I wanted to believe I was helping the family. But my brother paid the cost of what I hid.
ja: 私は家族を助けたのだと信じたかったのです。ですが、隠した代償は兄が払いました。
zh-CN: 我想相信自己是在帮助家人。但我隐藏的代价由哥哥付出了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실은 말년 기록을 정리하다 알게 됐습니다. 처음엔 저도 잘못 읽은 줄 알았습니다.
en: I learned that fact while organizing records from Mother's final years. At first, I thought I had read it wrong too.
ja: その事実は母の晩年の記録を整理している時に知りました。最初は私も読み間違えたのだと思いました。
zh-CN: 那个事实是我整理母亲晚年记录时知道的。一开始我也以为自己看错了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 숨긴 말을 제가 꺼내도 되는지 판단하지 못했습니다. 그래서 침묵했습니다.
en: I could not decide whether I was allowed to bring out the words Mother had hidden. So I stayed silent.
ja: 母が隠した言葉を私が出してよいのか判断できませんでした。だから沈黙しました。
zh-CN: 我无法判断自己是否可以把母亲隐藏的话说出来。所以我沉默了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 남긴 글을 보며 알게 됐습니다. 너무 무거워서 곧장 누구에게도 말하지 못했습니다.
en: I learned it while reading what Mother left behind. It was too heavy, and I could not tell anyone immediately.
ja: 母が残した文章を見て知りました。あまりに重く、すぐに誰にも言えませんでした。
zh-CN: 我是看着母亲留下的文字知道的。那太沉重了，我无法立刻告诉任何人。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 정확한 날짜보다 기억나는 건 충격입니다. 그 기록을 본 뒤 저는 혼자 확인을 반복했습니다.
en: What I remember more than the exact date is the shock. After seeing that record, I checked it alone again and again.
ja: 正確な日付より覚えているのは衝撃です。その記録を見た後、私は一人で何度も確認しました。
zh-CN: 比起准确日期，我记得更清楚的是冲击。看过那份记录后，我一个人反复确认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 자료를 정리하던 중에 알았습니다. 형에게 바로 건넬 수 있는 말이 아니었습니다.
en: I learned it while organizing Mother's materials. It was not something I could hand straight to my brother.
ja: 母の資料を整理している中で知りました。兄にすぐ渡せる言葉ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我是整理母亲资料时知道的。这不是能马上交给哥哥的话。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실을 안 순간부터 유서 문제도 다르게 보였습니다. 하지만 입 밖에 낼 자신이 없었습니다.
en: From the moment I learned that fact, the will issue looked different. But I did not have the courage to say it aloud.
ja: その事実を知った瞬間から、遺言書の問題も違って見えました。ですが、口に出す自信がありませんでした。
zh-CN: 知道那个事实的瞬间起，遗嘱问题也变得不同了。但我没有勇气说出口。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제가 먼저 알고도 침묵한 건 맞습니다. 다만 그 침묵이 가볍진 않았습니다.
en: Your Honor, it is true I knew first and stayed silent. But that silence was not light.
ja: 裁判官、私が先に知って沈黙したのは事実です。ただ、その沈黙は軽いものではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 法官，我先知道却沉默，这是事实。但那份沉默并不轻。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록 하나로 끝난 일이 아니었습니다. 앞뒤 사정이 맞물려 더는 모른 척하기 어려웠습니다.
en: It was not something that ended with one record. The surrounding circumstances fit together, and I could no longer pretend not to know.
ja: 記録一つで終わることではありませんでした。前後の事情がかみ合い、もう知らないふりは難しくなりました。
zh-CN: 这不是一份记录就结束的事。前后情况连在一起，我很难再装作不知道。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그때 저는 형보다 먼저 알아버린 사람이 됐습니다. 그 자체가 너무 무거웠습니다.
en: At that time, I became the person who knew before my brother did. That alone was too heavy.
ja: その時、私は兄より先に知ってしまった人になりました。それだけであまりに重かったです。
zh-CN: 那时，我成了比哥哥先知道的人。仅这一点就太沉重了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 혼자 감당하려 한 건 잘해서가 아닙니다. 누구에게 말해야 할지 몰라 멈춰 있었습니다.
en: I did not try to bear it alone because I was good at it. I stopped because I did not know whom to tell.
ja: 一人で抱えようとしたのは、うまくできるからではありません。誰に言えばいいのか分からず、止まっていました。
zh-CN: 我想一个人承担，并不是因为我做得好。而是不知道该告诉谁，所以停住了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제 출생과 관련한 민감한 사실은 어머니 말년 일기장을 정리하다 알게 됐습니다. 그 사실은 제가 함부로 꺼낼 수 없는 내용이었습니다.
en: I learned the sensitive fact tied to my birth while organizing Mother's diary from her final years. It was not something I could bring up carelessly.
ja: 私の出生に関わる敏感な事実は、母の晩年の日記帳を整理している時に知りました。その事実は、私がむやみに持ち出せる内容ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 与我出生有关的敏感事实，是我整理母亲晚年日记时知道的。那不是我可以随便说出口的内容。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 친자가 아니라는 사실을 제가 먼저 알았습니다. 그 후의 모든 선택은 두려움에서 벗어나지 못했습니다.
en: I learned before my brother that he was not Father's biological son. Every choice after that could not escape fear.
ja: 兄が父の実子ではないという事実を、私が先に知りました。その後のすべての選択は恐れから抜け出せませんでした。
zh-CN: 我先知道了哥哥不是父亲亲生儿子的事实。之后所有选择都没能摆脱恐惧。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 어머니 기록과 오래된 서류를 보고 제 출생과 관련한 민감한 사실을 확인했습니다. 그 뒤 혼자 숨겼습니다.
en: Your Honor, I confirmed a sensitive fact tied to my birth by reading Mother's records and old documents. After that, I hid it alone.
ja: 裁判官、私は母の記録と古い書類を見て、私の出生に関わる敏感な事実を確認しました。その後、一人で隠しました。
zh-CN: 法官，我看了母亲的记录和旧文件，确认了与我出生有关的敏感事实。之后我一个人把它藏了起来。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 처음엔 부정하고 싶었습니다. 하지만 기록들이 형이 아버지의 친자가 아니라는 사실로 이어졌습니다.
en: At first, I wanted to deny it. But the records led to the fact that my brother was not Father's biological son.
ja: 最初は否定したいと思いました。ですが、記録は兄が父の実子ではないという事実へつながりました。
zh-CN: 一开始我想否认。但那些记录指向了哥哥不是父亲亲生儿子的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 비밀을 알게 된 순간, 유서의 제 몫 90과 제가 보낸 돈이 모두 한 줄로 연결돼 보였습니다.
en: The moment I learned that secret, the 90 share in the will and the money I had sent all seemed to connect in one line.
ja: その秘密を知った瞬間、遺言書の私の取り分90と私が送った金がすべて一本の線でつながって見えました。
zh-CN: 知道那个秘密的瞬间，遗嘱里我90的份额和我汇出的钱，全都像连成了一条线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 그 사실을 들으면 장남으로 살아온 삶이 무너질 거라 단정했습니다. 그래서 말하지 않았습니다.
en: I decided that if my brother heard that fact, the life he had lived as eldest son would collapse. So I did not tell him.
ja: 兄がその事実を聞けば、長男として生きてきた人生が崩れると私が決めつけました。だから言いませんでした。
zh-CN: 我断定哥哥如果听到那个事实，他作为长子活过的人生会崩塌。所以我没有说。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 숨긴 그 사실을 제가 대신 지킨다고 착각했습니다. 결국 형에게서 알 권리를 빼앗았습니다.
en: I mistook myself for the one protecting the fact Mother had hidden. In the end, I took away my brother's right to know.
ja: 母が隠したその事実を、私が代わりに守っていると勘違いしました。結局、兄から知る権利を奪いました。
zh-CN: 我误以为自己是在替母亲守住那个被隐藏的事实。最终，我夺走了哥哥的知情权。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실을 안 뒤 저는 법정까지 오지 않게 하려 했습니다. 형이 여기서 그 말을 듣게 될까 봐 두려웠습니다.
en: After learning that fact, I tried to keep it from coming to court. I was afraid my brother would hear those words here.
ja: その事実を知った後、私は法廷まで来ないようにしようとしました。兄がここでその言葉を聞くのが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 知道那个事实后，我试图不让事情走到法庭。我害怕哥哥会在这里听到那句话。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형과 관련한 그 사실을 혼자 쥔 채 문서 처리까지 제 방식으로 밀어붙였습니다. 지키려 했다는 말로 덮을 수 없는 책임입니다.
en: Holding that fact about my brother alone, I pushed the document handling in my own way. It is a responsibility that cannot be covered by saying I was trying to protect him.
ja: 兄に関わるその事実を一人で握ったまま、文書処理まで自分のやり方で押し進めました。守ろうとしたという言葉では覆えない責任です。
zh-CN: 我一个人握着与哥哥有关的那个事实，还把文件处理也按自己的方式推进。这份责任不能用“想保护他”来遮盖。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 어머니 일기장을 본 사람이고, 형에게 말하지 않은 사람입니다. 변명하지 않겠습니다.
en: Your Honor, I am the person who saw Mother's diary, and the person who did not tell my brother. I will not make excuses.
ja: 裁判官、私は母の日記帳を見た人であり、兄に言わなかった人です。言い訳はしません。
zh-CN: 法官，我是看过母亲日记的人，也是没有告诉哥哥的人。我不辩解。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제 뿌리에 관한 그 사실은 어머니 일기와 오래된 서류가 맞물리며 알게 됐습니다.
en: I learned that fact about my roots through Mother's diary and old documents fitting together.
ja: 私の根に関わるその事実は、母の日記と古い書類がかみ合って分かりました。
zh-CN: 关于我根源的那个事实，是母亲日记和旧文件相互印证后让我知道的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 혼자 감당하려 했다는 말은 맞습니다. 하지만 그건 강함이 아니라 겁이었습니다.
en: It is true I tried to bear it alone. But that was fear, not strength.
ja: 一人で抱えようとしたという言葉は事実です。けれど、それは強さではなく恐れでした。
zh-CN: 我确实想一个人承受。但那不是坚强，而是害怕。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말년 기록을 정리하다 형이 믿어 온 가족의 자리가 다를 수 있다는 사실을 확인했습니다.
en: While organizing records from Mother's final years, I confirmed that the family position my brother had believed in might not be what he thought.
ja: 母の晩年の記録を整理する中で、兄が信じてきた家族の位置が違うかもしれないという事実を確認しました。
zh-CN: 整理母亲晚年记录时，我确认了哥哥一直相信的家庭位置可能并非如此。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 남긴 문장과 자료가 한 결론으로 이어졌습니다. 저는 그때부터 혼자 버티기 시작했습니다.
en: Mother's sentences and the materials she left led to one conclusion. From then on, I began enduring it alone.
ja: 母が残した文章と資料は一つの結論へつながりました。私はその時から一人で耐え始めました。
zh-CN: 母亲留下的文字和资料导向同一个结论。从那时起，我开始独自承受。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실을 알자마자 형에게 말할 수 없었습니다. 유서 비율과 돈의 흐름까지 같이 설명해야 했기 때문입니다.
en: I could not tell my brother as soon as I learned it. I would also have had to explain the will ratio and the money trail.
ja: その事実を知った直後、兄に言うことはできませんでした。遺言書の比率と金の流れまで一緒に説明しなければならなかったからです。
zh-CN: 知道那个事实后，我无法立刻告诉哥哥。因为遗嘱比例和钱的流向也必须一起说明。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 단순한 소문이 아니었습니다. 어머니 기록이 형의 삶에 관한 무거운 사실을 가리켰습니다.
en: Your Honor, it was not a simple rumor. Mother's records pointed to a heavy fact about my brother's life.
ja: 裁判官、単なる噂ではありませんでした。母の記録は兄の人生に関わる重い事実を示していました。
zh-CN: 法官，那不是简单的传言。母亲的记录指向了与哥哥人生有关的沉重事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 알면 상속 문제가 아니라 자기 삶을 다시 보게 될 거라고 봤습니다.
en: I thought that if my brother knew, it would not be an inheritance issue but a reason to look at his own life again.
ja: 兄が知れば、相続問題ではなく自分の人生を見直すことになると思いました。
zh-CN: 我认为哥哥如果知道，那就不只是继承问题，而是要重新看待自己的人生。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그때부터 저는 돈과 유서, 어머니 말년을 한꺼번에 묶어 생각했습니다. 그래서 더 침묵했습니다.
en: From then on, I thought of money, the will, and Mother's final years all at once. So I stayed even more silent.
ja: その時から私は、金と遺言書、母の晩年を一度に結びつけて考えました。だからさらに沈黙しました。
zh-CN: 从那时起，我把钱、遗嘱和母亲晚年一起捆在脑子里想。所以更加沉默。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게 말하지 않은 건 진실을 독점하려던 게 아닙니다. 감당할 방법을 못 찾은 겁니다.
en: I did not keep it from my brother because I wanted to monopolize the truth. I could not find a way to handle it.
ja: 兄に言わなかったのは、真実を独占しようとしたからではありません。受け止める方法を見つけられなかったのです。
zh-CN: 我没有告诉哥哥，并不是想独占真相。而是找不到承受和处理的方法。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실을 알게 된 뒤 저는 어머니 뜻을 그대로 둘 용기도, 형에게 말할 용기도 없었습니다.
en: After learning that fact, I had neither the courage to leave Mother's wishes as they were nor the courage to tell my brother.
ja: その事実を知った後、私は母の意思をそのままにする勇気も、兄に話す勇気もありませんでした。
zh-CN: 知道那个事实之后，我既没有勇气保持母亲的意愿原样，也没有勇气告诉哥哥。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 그 사실을 알면 견디기 어려울 거라고 봤습니다. 그래서 일이 법정으로 커지는 게 두려웠습니다.
en: I thought my brother could hardly bear it if he learned that fact. That is why I feared the matter growing into a court case.
ja: 兄がその事実を知れば耐え難いだろうと思いました。だから事が法廷へ大きくなるのが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我觉得哥哥知道那个事实后会难以承受。所以我害怕事情扩大到法庭。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그때는 다투지 않게 하는 것이 형을 지키는 길이라고 믿었습니다. 지금은 그 믿음도 흔들립니다.
en: At the time, I believed keeping us from fighting was the way to protect my brother. Now that belief is shaken too.
ja: その時は、争わないようにすることが兄を守る道だと信じていました。今はその信念も揺らいでいます。
zh-CN: 当时我相信不让我们争起来就是保护哥哥的方式。现在这个信念也动摇了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상속 이야기가 길어질수록 더 깊은 말이 나올 수밖에 없었습니다. 저는 그걸 막고 싶었습니다.
en: The longer the inheritance discussion continued, the deeper words would have to come out. I wanted to stop that.
ja: 相続の話が長引くほど、もっと深い言葉が出ざるを得ませんでした。私はそれを止めたかったのです。
zh-CN: 继承的话题拖得越久，更深的话就必然会出来。我想阻止那一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 몰라도 된다고 생각한 건 아닙니다. 다만 그 순간에 알게 되는 건 너무 잔인하다고 봤습니다.
en: I did not think my brother did not need to know. I only thought learning it at that moment would be too cruel.
ja: 兄が知らなくていいと思ったわけではありません。ただ、その瞬間に知るのはあまりに残酷だと思いました。
zh-CN: 我不是认为哥哥可以不知道。只是觉得在那个时刻让他知道太残酷了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 법정에 오면 기록이 다 열립니다. 저는 그 과정이 형에게 너무 큰 상처가 될까 봐 겁났습니다.
en: If we came to court, the records would all open. I feared that process would wound my brother too deeply.
ja: 法廷に来れば、記録がすべて開かれます。その過程が兄にあまりに大きな傷になるのではないかと怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 如果来到法庭，记录都会被打开。我害怕这个过程会给哥哥造成太大的伤害。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제 판단은 상대에게 알려지길 피하려는 쪽이었습니다. 하지만 그 판단을 제가 해도 되는지는 별개입니다.
en: Your Honor, my judgment leaned toward avoiding the other side finding out. Whether I had the right to make that judgment is another matter.
ja: 裁判官、私の判断は相手に知られるのを避ける方向でした。しかし、その判断を私がしてよいのかは別問題です。
zh-CN: 法官，我的判断偏向于避免对方知道。但我是否可以作出这种判断，是另一回事。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실 하나가 상속보다 큰 문제라는 걸 알았습니다. 그래서 조용히 끝내려 했습니다.
en: I knew that one fact was a larger issue than inheritance. So I tried to end it quietly.
ja: その事実一つが相続より大きな問題だと分かりました。だから静かに終わらせようとしました。
zh-CN: 我知道那个事实本身比继承更大。所以我想安静地结束。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형에게 말할 방법을 찾지 못했습니다. 그래서 법정에 오지 않게 막는 쪽으로만 생각했습니다.
en: I could not find a way to tell my brother. So I only thought about blocking the case from reaching court.
ja: 兄に話す方法を見つけられませんでした。だから法廷に来ないように止めることだけを考えました。
zh-CN: 我找不到告诉哥哥的方法。所以只想着不让事情来到法庭。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 준비 없이 듣게 될까 봐 두려웠습니다. 두려워서 선택지를 너무 좁게 봤습니다.
en: I feared my brother would hear it before he was ready. Out of fear, I narrowed the options too much.
ja: 兄が準備のないまま聞くのではないかと怖かったのです。怖くて選択肢をあまりに狭く見ました。
zh-CN: 我害怕哥哥会在没有准备的情况下听到。因为害怕，我把选择看得太窄了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 막으려 한 건 판결 자체보다 그 과정에서 나올 말들이었습니다.
en: What I tried to stop was not the verdict itself, but the words that would come out during the process.
ja: 私が止めようとしたのは判決そのものより、その過程で出てくる言葉でした。
zh-CN: 我想阻止的不是判决本身，而是过程中会出现的那些话。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 맞습니다. 형이 그 사실을 알면 삶의 기반이 무너질까 봐 법정까지 오지 않게 하려 했습니다.
en: Yes. I tried to keep the case from reaching court because I feared my brother's foundation in life would collapse if he learned that fact.
ja: そのとおりです。兄がその事実を知れば人生の基盤が崩れるのではないかと怖くて、法廷まで来ないようにしようとしました。
zh-CN: 是的。我担心哥哥知道那个事实后人生基础会崩塌，所以试图不让事情走到法庭。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형의 삶을 지켜 주겠다는 생각이 형의 삶을 제가 멋대로 다루는 일이 됐습니다.
en: Your Honor, my thought that I was protecting my brother's life became an act of handling his life as I pleased.
ja: 裁判官、兄の人生を守ってやるという考えが、兄の人生を私が勝手に扱うことになりました。
zh-CN: 法官，我以为是在保护哥哥的人生，结果却成了我擅自摆弄哥哥的人生。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 형이 아버지의 친자가 아니라는 사실을 이 자리에서 듣게 될까 봐 모든 걸 막으려 했습니다.
en: Your Honor, I tried to block everything because I feared my brother would hear in this courtroom that he was not Father's biological son.
ja: 裁判官、兄が父の実子ではないという事実をこの場で聞くのではないかと怖くて、私はすべてを止めようとしました。
zh-CN: 法官，我害怕哥哥会在这里听到自己不是父亲亲生儿子的事实，所以试图阻止一切。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 지킨다는 이유로 유서를 고치고 돈의 출처도 숨겼습니다. 결국 법정에서 더 크게 터졌습니다.
en: In the name of protecting my brother, I changed the will and hid the source of the money. In the end, it burst out even more painfully in court.
ja: 兄を守るという理由で遺言書を直し、金の出所も隠しました。結局、法廷でさらに大きく噴き出しました。
zh-CN: 我以保护哥哥为由改了遗嘱，也隐藏了钱的来源。结果在法庭上更大地爆发了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 그 비밀을 알 권리보다 제 두려움을 앞세웠습니다. 그게 제 가장 큰 잘못입니다.
en: I put my fear ahead of my brother's right to know that secret. That is my greatest fault.
ja: 兄がその秘密を知る権利より、私の恐れを優先しました。それが私の最も大きな過ちです。
zh-CN: 我把自己的恐惧放在了哥哥知道那个秘密的权利之前。这是我最大的错误。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 민감한 가족사가 드러나지 않게 하려고 제 몫 90, 형 몫 10인 자필 연습본을 제 몫 60, 형 몫 40으로 낮췄습니다. 그 선택은 제가 했습니다.
en: To keep the sensitive family matter from coming out, I lowered the handwritten draft from 90 for me and 10 for my brother to 60 for me and 40 for him. That choice was mine.
ja: 敏感な家族史が明らかにならないよう、私90・兄10の自筆下書きを、私60・兄40へ下げました。その選択は私がしました。
zh-CN: 为了不让敏感的家事暴露，我把亲笔草稿中我90、哥哥10的比例降成了我60、哥哥40。这个选择是我作的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 무너질 거라는 판단을 제가 대신 내렸습니다. 형에게 물어볼 용기가 없었습니다.
en: I decided in my brother's place that he would collapse. I did not have the courage to ask him.
ja: 兄が崩れるだろうという判断を、私が代わりに下しました。兄に聞く勇気がありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我替哥哥作出了“他会崩溃”的判断。我没有勇气问他。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 법정까지 가지 않게 하려 한 건 사실입니다. 형이 자기 뿌리를 법정 자료로 알게 될까 봐 겁났습니다.
en: It is true I tried to keep it from going to court. I feared my brother would learn about his roots through court materials.
ja: 法廷まで行かせまいとしたのは事実です。兄が自分の根を法廷資料で知ることになるのが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 我确实想避免走到法庭。我害怕哥哥会通过法庭资料知道自己的根源。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 비밀을 숨기려다 어머니 뜻도 형의 알 권리도 함께 가렸습니다. 이제는 인정합니다.
en: While trying to hide that secret, I also covered Mother's wishes and my brother's right to know. I admit that now.
ja: その秘密を隠そうとして、母の意思も兄の知る権利も一緒に覆いました。今は認めます。
zh-CN: 为了隐藏那个秘密，我连母亲的意愿和哥哥的知情权也一起遮住了。现在我承认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 지키겠다는 말로는 부족합니다. 저는 형이 알아야 할 가장 큰 사실을 제 손으로 늦췄습니다.
en: Saying I wanted to protect my brother is not enough. I delayed with my own hands the most important fact he needed to know.
ja: 兄を守りたかったという言葉では足りません。兄が知るべき最も大きな事実を、私の手で遅らせました。
zh-CN: 说我想保护哥哥是不够的。我亲手推迟了他应当知道的最大事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 법정으로 오면 유서, 돈, 어머니 기록이 모두 열립니다. 형이 그 연결을 견디기 어렵다고 봤습니다.
en: If it came to court, the will, the money, and Mother's records would all open. I thought my brother could not endure that connection.
ja: 法廷に来れば、遺言書、金、母の記録がすべて開かれます。兄はそのつながりに耐えにくいと思いました。
zh-CN: 如果来到法庭，遗嘱、钱和母亲记录都会被打开。我认为哥哥难以承受这条联系。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 질문을 멈추길 바랐습니다. 질문이 계속되면 제가 감춘 모든 일이 드러날 테니까요.
en: I wanted my brother to stop asking questions. If the questions continued, everything I had hidden would come out.
ja: 兄に質問を止めてほしいと思いました。質問が続けば、私が隠していたすべてが明らかになるからです。
zh-CN: 我希望哥哥停止追问。如果问题继续，我隐藏的一切都会暴露。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 그 사실을 알면 자신이 장남으로 살아온 시간을 의심할 거라고 생각했습니다.
en: I thought that if my brother learned that fact, he would doubt the years he had lived as eldest son.
ja: 兄がその事実を知れば、長男として生きてきた時間を疑うだろうと思いました。
zh-CN: 我认为哥哥知道那个事实后，会怀疑自己作为长子生活过的那些年。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형이 상속 비율보다 그 이유에 더 무너질 거라 봤습니다. 그래서 법정까지 막으려 했습니다.
en: I believed my brother would be broken more by the reason than by the inheritance ratio. So I tried to stop it from reaching court.
ja: 兄は相続比率よりもその理由に崩れるだろうと見ました。だから法廷まで止めようとしました。
zh-CN: 我认为哥哥会被比例背后的理由击垮，而不是被继承比例本身。所以我想阻止它走到法庭。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형을 지키겠다면서 결국 제가 진실의 순서를 정했습니다.
en: Your Honor, while saying I would protect my brother, I ended up deciding the order in which the truth would be told.
ja: 裁判官、兄を守ると言いながら、結局は私が真実の順序を決めました。
zh-CN: 法官，我说是要保护哥哥，结果却由我决定了真相出现的顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 사실이 드러나면 형은 어머니 사랑과 돈의 흐름까지 전부 다시 보게 될 겁니다. 그게 두려웠습니다.
en: If that fact came out, my brother would have to reconsider Mother's love and the flow of money together. That frightened me.
ja: その事実が明らかになれば、兄は母の愛と金の流れまで全部見直すことになります。それが怖かったのです。
zh-CN: 如果那个事实暴露，哥哥就会连母亲的爱和钱的流向都全部重新审视。我害怕这一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형에게 시간을 주는 대신 진실을 늦췄습니다. 그 선택이 옳았다고는 이제 못 말합니다.
en: Instead of giving my brother time, I delayed the truth. I can no longer say that choice was right.
ja: 兄に時間を与える代わりに、真実を遅らせました。その選択が正しかったとは、もう言えません。
zh-CN: 我没有给哥哥时间，而是拖延了真相。现在我不能再说这个选择是对的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 법정에 오지 않게 하려 한 건 맞습니다. 이유는 형이 받을 충격을 제가 감당하지 못했기 때문입니다.
en: It is true I tried to keep it from court. The reason was that I could not bear the shock my brother would receive.
ja: 法廷に来ないようにしようとしたのは事実です。理由は、兄が受ける衝撃を私が受け止められなかったからです。
zh-CN: 我确实试图不让事情来到法庭。原因是我承受不了哥哥会受到的冲击。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 알 권리보다 형이 무너지지 않는 모습을 먼저 골랐습니다. 그건 제 오만이었습니다.
en: I chose my brother not collapsing over his right to know. That was my arrogance.
ja: 兄の知る権利より、兄が崩れない姿を先に選びました。それは私の傲慢でした。
zh-CN: 我把哥哥不崩溃的样子放在他的知情权之前。这是我的傲慢。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상속 분쟁으로 포장하면 비밀이 묻힐 거라 생각했습니다. 하지만 숨김은 더 커졌습니다.
en: I thought that if I wrapped it as an inheritance dispute, the secret would stay buried. But the concealment only grew larger.
ja: 相続紛争として包めば秘密は埋もれると思いました。ですが、隠し事はさらに大きくなりました。
zh-CN: 我以为把它包装成继承纠纷，秘密就会被埋住。但隐瞒反而变得更大了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱을 세우고도 말끝에서 잠깐 흔들린다.
en: Even with his chin lifted, he wavers briefly at the end.
ja: 顎を上げていても、語尾で一瞬揺れる。
zh-CN: 即使抬着下巴，句尾也短暂动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 장남이니 더 받아야 한다고 단순히 말한 건 아닙니다. 다만 제가 해 온 시간이 무시된 느낌은 컸습니다.
en: I did not simply say I should receive more because I am the eldest son. But it felt strongly as if the time I spent caring for her had been ignored.
ja: 長男だからもっと受け取るべきだと単純に言ったわけではありません。ただ、私がしてきた時間が無視された感じは強くありました。
zh-CN: 我并不是简单地说自己是长子所以该多拿。但我确实强烈觉得自己付出的时间被忽视了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 내리지 않으려 애쓰며 답한다.
en: Answers while trying not to lower his gaze.
ja: 視線を落とさないよう努めながら答える。
zh-CN: 努力不低下视线地回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 제 몫을 먼저 생각했습니다. 그 마음이 없었다고 말하면 거짓말입니다.
en: I thought of my share first. It would be a lie to say that feeling was not there.
ja: 私は自分の取り分を先に考えました。その気持ちがなかったと言えば嘘になります。
zh-CN: 我先想到的是自己的份额。如果说没有这种心情，那就是谎话。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리를 낮추려 하지만 억울함이 먼저 나온다.
en: Tries to lower his voice, but grievance comes out first.
ja: 声を落とそうとするが、悔しさが先に出る。
zh-CN: 试图压低声音，但委屈先冒出来。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 어머니 곁을 지킨 시간이 있었습니다. 그 시간이 몫에 반영돼야 한다고 여긴 마음은 있습니다.
en: I spent time staying by Mother's side. I did feel that time should be reflected in my share.
ja: 私は母のそばを守ってきた時間がありました。その時間が取り分に反映されるべきだと思う気持ちはあります。
zh-CN: 我有守在母亲身边的时间。我确实觉得那段时间应该反映在份额里。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손끝으로 책상을 누르며 방어적으로 답한다.
en: Presses the desk with his fingertips and answers defensively.
ja: 指先で机を押さえ、防御的に答える。
zh-CN: 用指尖按着桌面，防御性地回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생 돈이었다는 말이 나와도 제가 억울하지 않은 건 아닙니다. 저는 제가 돌본 시간을 먼저 봤습니다.
en: Even after hearing it was my brother's money, I did not stop feeling wronged. I first looked at the time I had cared for her.
ja: 弟の金だったという話が出ても、私が悔しくないわけではありません。私は自分が介護した時間を先に見ました。
zh-CN: 即使听说那是弟弟的钱，我也不是不委屈。我先看见的是自己照顾母亲的时间。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생 쪽을 흘겨보고 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Glances sideways at his younger brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 弟の方を横目で見て、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 斜眼看向弟弟，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제가 장남이라는 자리를 가볍게 여긴 적은 없습니다. 그래서 더 흔들렸습니다.
en: Your Honor, I have never taken the position of eldest son lightly. That is why I was shaken even more.
ja: 裁判官、私は長男という立場を軽く見たことはありません。だからこそ、より揺れました。
zh-CN: 法官，我从没有轻看长子这个位置。所以才更加动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 분노를 누르지만 어깨에 힘이 남아 있다.
en: Suppresses anger, but tension remains in his shoulders.
ja: 怒りを抑えるが、肩には力が残っている。
zh-CN: 压住愤怒，但肩膀仍有力道。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 받아야 한다고 우긴다기보다, 적게 남겨진 이유를 받아들이기 어려웠습니다.
en: It was less that I insisted I must receive more, and more that I could not accept why so little was left to me.
ja: もっと受け取るべきだと押し通したというより、少なく残された理由を受け入れにくかったのです。
zh-CN: 与其说我坚持自己必须多拿，不如说我很难接受为什么只留给我那么少。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 세게 시작했다가 끝에서 조금 물러선다.
en: Starts forcefully, then pulls back a little at the end.
ja: 強く話し始め、最後で少し退く。
zh-CN: 开头说得很强，到结尾稍稍退让。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 당연하게 여긴 부분이 있었을 수 있습니다. 하지만 그게 전부 욕심이었다고는 못 하겠습니다.
en: There may have been parts I took for granted. But I cannot say all of it was greed.
ja: 私が当然視していた部分はあったかもしれません。ですが、それがすべて欲だったとは言えません。
zh-CN: 我可能有把某些事当成理所当然的部分。但不能说那全都是贪心。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자기 몫을 말할 때 숨이 짧아진다.
en: His breath shortens when he talks about his share.
ja: 自分の取り分を話す時、息が短くなる。
zh-CN: 说到自己份额时呼吸变短。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니를 모신 사람으로서 기대가 있었습니다. 그 기대를 완전히 부정하긴 어렵습니다.
en: As the one who cared for Mother, I had expectations. It is hard to deny those expectations completely.
ja: 母を見てきた人間として、期待がありました。その期待を完全に否定するのは難しいです。
zh-CN: 作为照顾母亲的人，我有期待。很难完全否认那份期待。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오랜 돌봄을 떠올리며 표정이 굳는다.
en: His expression stiffens as he recalls years of care.
ja: 長い介護を思い出し、表情が固まる。
zh-CN: 想起长期照护，表情变硬。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생이 도왔다는 말을 듣고도, 제가 곁에 있었다는 사실이 사라지진 않는다고 생각했습니다.
en: Even after hearing my brother had helped, I thought the fact that I had stayed beside her did not disappear.
ja: 弟が助けていたと聞いても、私がそばにいた事実が消えるわけではないと思いました。
zh-CN: 即使听到弟弟也帮过忙，我仍觉得自己在母亲身边这件事不会消失。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 억울함을 앞세우다 스스로 문장을 고른다.
en: Leads with grievance, then chooses his own sentence.
ja: 悔しさを先に出しながら、自分で文を選ぶ。
zh-CN: 先带出委屈，又自己斟酌句子。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이라는 자리와 돌본 시간이 제 마음속에서 섞여 있었습니다. 그 점은 인정합니다.
en: The position of older brother and the time I spent caring for her were mixed together in my mind. I admit that.
ja: 兄という立場と介護した時間が、私の心の中で混ざっていました。その点は認めます。
zh-CN: 哥哥这个位置和照顾母亲的时间，在我心里混在了一起。这点我承认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 처음으로 목소리를 낮춘다.
en: With head lowered, lowers his voice for the first time.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、初めて声を落とす。
zh-CN: 低着头，第一次压低声音。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 인정합니다. 저는 장남이라는 이유로 더 받을 자격이 있다고 믿었고, 어머니 뜻을 제 기준으로 읽었습니다.
en: I admit it. I believed that as the eldest son I deserved more, and I read Mother's wishes by my own standard.
ja: 認めます。私は長男という理由で、より受け取る資格があると信じ、母の意思を自分の基準で読みました。
zh-CN: 我承认。我曾相信自己作为长子有资格多拿，并且用自己的标准解读母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 한참 침묵한 뒤 차분히 고백한다.
en: After a long silence, confesses calmly.
ja: しばらく沈黙した後、落ち着いて告白する。
zh-CN: 长时间沉默后，平静坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 이제 인정하겠습니다. 장남이라는 이름이 제게 권리처럼 느껴졌고, 그 마음이 판단을 흐렸습니다.
en: I will admit it now. The name of eldest son felt like a right to me, and that feeling clouded my judgment.
ja: 今は認めます。長男という名前が私には権利のように感じられ、その心が判断を曇らせました。
zh-CN: 现在我承认。长子这个名分对我来说像一种权利，这种心情模糊了我的判断。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 분노가 빠진 자리에서 부끄러움이 올라온다.
en: Where anger fades, shame rises.
ja: 怒りが抜けた場所から恥ずかしさが上がる。
zh-CN: 愤怒退去后，羞愧浮现。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 어머니를 모신 시간을 유산의 증거처럼 붙잡았습니다. 그 마음이 사건을 키웠습니다.
en: Your Honor, I held on to the time I cared for Mother as if it were proof for the inheritance. That feeling enlarged the case.
ja: 裁判官、私は母を看た時間を相続の証拠のように握りしめました。その気持ちが事件を大きくしました。
zh-CN: 法官，我把照顾母亲的时间当成继承的证据一样紧抓着。这种心情把事情扩大了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손을 무릎 위에 모으고 천천히 인정한다.
en: Folds his hands on his knees and slowly admits it.
ja: 手を膝の上にそろえ、ゆっくり認める。
zh-CN: 双手放在膝上，慢慢承认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생이 숨겨 온 돈을 알고도 제 억울함만 먼저 봤습니다. 제 당연시도 책임입니다.
en: Even after learning about the money my brother had hidden, I first looked only at my own grievance. My assumption of entitlement is also my responsibility.
ja: 弟が隠してきた金を知っても、私は先に自分の悔しさだけを見ました。私の当然視にも責任があります。
zh-CN: 即使知道弟弟隐藏的钱，我首先看的还是自己的委屈。我的理所当然也有责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생 이름을 부르려다 재판관에게만 말한다.
en: Starts to say his brother's name, then speaks only to the Judge.
ja: 弟の名前を呼ぼうとして、裁判官にだけ話す。
zh-CN: 想叫弟弟的名字，却只对法官说话。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 어머니를 있는 그대로 보기보다 제 수고를 인정해 줄 사람으로 붙잡았습니다.
en: Rather than seeing Mother as she was, I held on to her as someone who should recognize my effort.
ja: 私は母をありのまま見るより、自分の苦労を認めてくれる人として握りしめていました。
zh-CN: 比起如实看待母亲，我把她抓成了应该承认我辛苦的人。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 버틴 자존심이 꺾인 듯 숨을 쉰다.
en: Breathes as if long-held pride has bent.
ja: 長く耐えていた自尊心が折れたように息をする。
zh-CN: 像长期撑着的自尊被折断一样呼吸。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 장남 자리를 잃을까 두려워서 숫자에 더 매달렸습니다. 두려워서 동생을 악의로만 보게 됐습니다.
en: I clung harder to the numbers because I feared losing the place of eldest son. Out of fear, I saw my brother only as malicious.
ja: 長男の場所を失うのが怖くて、数字にさらにしがみつきました。怖くて弟を悪意だけで見てしまいました。
zh-CN: 我因为害怕失去长子的位置，才更加执着于数字。因为害怕，我只把弟弟看成恶意。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지고 시선이 손등에 머문다.
en: His ending drops, and his gaze rests on the back of his hand.
ja: 語尾が低くなり、視線が手の甲に留まる。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，视线停在手背上。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 묻기 전에 제 몫을 계산했습니다. 그게 제가 어머니를 이용한 방식입니다.
en: Before asking what Mother wanted, I calculated my share. That is how I used Mother.
ja: 母の意思を尋ねる前に、自分の取り分を計算しました。それが、私が母を利用した形です。
zh-CN: 在询问母亲意愿之前，我先计算了自己的份额。这就是我利用母亲的方式。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자기 책임을 말할 때 어깨가 내려간다.
en: His shoulders drop when he speaks of his own responsibility.
ja: 自分の責任を話す時、肩が落ちる。
zh-CN: 说到自己的责任时肩膀垂下。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생만 어머니를 바꾼 게 아닙니다. 저도 어머니 마음을 제 편의 증거로 쓰려 했습니다.
en: My brother was not the only one who changed Mother. I also tried to use Mother's heart as evidence for my side.
ja: 母を変えたのは弟だけではありません。私も母の心を自分に都合のよい証拠として使おうとしました。
zh-CN: 改变母亲的不只是弟弟。我也试图把母亲的心意当成有利于自己的证据。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목이 잠기지만 문장을 끝까지 마친다.
en: His throat tightens, but he finishes the sentence.
ja: 喉が詰まるが、文を最後まで言い切る。
zh-CN: 嗓子发紧，但把句子说完。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 돌본 건 사실이지만, 그 사실로 더 받아야 한다고 밀어붙인 마음도 사실입니다.
en: It is true I cared for her, but it is also true I pushed with the feeling that I should receive more for it.
ja: 私が介護したのは事実ですが、その事実でより受け取るべきだと押し通した心も事実です。
zh-CN: 我照顾过她是事实，但我也确实以此推动“自己应该多拿”的想法。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 변명하려는 버릇을 누르고 인정으로 끝낸다.
en: Suppresses the habit of making excuses and ends with an admission.
ja: 言い訳しようとする癖を抑え、認める形で終える。
zh-CN: 压住想辩解的习惯，以承认结束。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 어머니의 마지막 뜻보다 제 상처와 자존심을 먼저 세웠습니다.
en: Your Honor, I put my own hurt and pride ahead of Mother's final wishes.
ja: 裁判官、私は母の最後の意思より、自分の傷と自尊心を先に立てました。
zh-CN: 法官，我把自己的伤和自尊放在了母亲最后的意愿之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 반박하려다 말을 삼키고 낮게 인정한다.
en: Starts to object, swallows the words, and admits quietly.
ja: 反論しかけて言葉を飲み込み、低く認める。
zh-CN: 想反驳又咽回话，低声承认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 인정합니다. 장남이라는 이유로 어머니 재산에서 제 자리가 더 크다고 생각한 마음이 있었습니다.
en: I admit it. There was a part of me that thought my place in Mother's estate should be larger because I was the eldest son.
ja: 認めます。長男という理由で、母の財産における自分の場所がもっと大きいと思う気持ちがありました。
zh-CN: 我承认。因为自己是长子，我心里曾觉得自己在母亲财产中的位置应该更大。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 비난의 톤이 약해지며 자책이 섞인다.
en: The blaming tone weakens, with self-reproach mixed in.
ja: 非難の調子が弱まり、自責が混じる。
zh-CN: 责备的语气减弱，夹杂自责。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 어머니 마음을 묻기보다 제 수고의 값을 먼저 따졌습니다. 그 점은 부끄럽습니다.
en: I asked the price of my own labor before asking Mother's heart. I am ashamed of that.
ja: 母の心を問うより、自分の苦労の値を先に考えました。その点は恥ずかしいです。
zh-CN: 我没有先问母亲的心意，而是先计算自己辛苦的价值。这点让我羞愧。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손바닥을 펴다 접으며 자존심을 누른다.
en: Opens and closes his palm, suppressing his pride.
ja: 手のひらを開いて閉じ、自尊心を抑える。
zh-CN: 摊开又合上手掌，压住自尊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생 돈이 섞였다는 걸 듣고도 처음엔 제 수고가 먼저 떠올랐습니다. 그만큼 제가 제 몫을 당연시했습니다.
en: Even after hearing my brother's money was mixed in, I first thought of my own effort. That shows how much I took my share for granted.
ja: 弟の金が混じっていたと聞いても、最初に私の苦労が浮かびました。それほど私は自分の取り分を当然視していました。
zh-CN: 即使听说其中混有弟弟的钱，我一开始想到的仍是自己的辛苦。这说明我把自己的份额当成理所当然到什么程度。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리는 거칠지만 인정 대목은 피하지 않는다.
en: His voice is rough, but he does not avoid the admission.
ja: 声は荒いが、認める部分は避けない。
zh-CN: 声音粗硬，但不回避承认的部分。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 모신 시간을 보상처럼 붙잡았습니다. 그래서 숫자가 모욕으로 느껴졌습니다.
en: Your Honor, I held on to the time I cared for her as compensation. That is why the numbers felt like an insult.
ja: 裁判官、私は介護した時間を補償のように握りしめました。だから数字が侮辱のように感じられました。
zh-CN: 法官，我把照顾她的时间当成补偿一样紧抓着。所以那些数字让我觉得像羞辱。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생을 보려다 시선을 바닥으로 내린다.
en: Starts to look at his younger brother, then lowers his gaze to the floor.
ja: 弟を見ようとして、視線を床へ落とす。
zh-CN: 想看向弟弟，却把视线落到地面。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 장남이라는 말을 앞세운 건 사실입니다. 그 말로 동생이 숨겨 둔 도움을 밀어낸 부분도 있습니다.
en: It is true I put the word eldest son first. With that word, I also pushed aside the help my brother had hidden.
ja: 私が長男という言葉を前に出したのは事実です。その言葉で、弟が隠していた支援を押しのけた部分もあります。
zh-CN: 我确实把长子这个词摆在前面。也正因为这个词，我排开了弟弟隐藏的帮助。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 장남이라는 말을 꺼내고 바로 멈칫한다.
en: Says the words "eldest son" and immediately hesitates.
ja: 長男という言葉を出して、すぐにためらう。
zh-CN: 说出“长子”后立刻犹豫。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻보다 제 억울함을 먼저 세웠습니다. 그 안에 당연히 더 받아야 한다는 생각이 있었습니다.
en: I put my grievance ahead of Mother's wishes. Inside that was the thought that I naturally deserved more.
ja: 母の意思より自分の悔しさを先に立てました。その中には、当然もっと受け取るべきだという考えがありました。
zh-CN: 我把自己的委屈放在母亲意愿之前。其中也有“我理所当然该多拿”的想法。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 분노보다 혼란이 앞서 말속도가 늦어진다.
en: Confusion comes before anger, and his speech slows.
ja: 怒りより混乱が先に立ち、話す速度が遅くなる。
zh-CN: 混乱先于愤怒，说话速度放慢。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 돌본 일과 상속을 너무 붙여 봤습니다. 제가 한 일을 이유로 더 받을 자격을 확신했습니다.
en: I tied caregiving and inheritance too closely. I was certain my work entitled me to more.
ja: 介護と相続をあまりに結びつけて見ました。自分がしたことを理由に、より受け取る資格があると確信していました。
zh-CN: 我把照顾和继承看得太紧密。我确信自己做过的事让我有资格多拿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 누르며 억울함을 정리한다.
en: Presses the edge of the desk while organizing his grievance.
ja: 机の角を押さえながら、悔しさを整理する。
zh-CN: 按着桌角，整理自己的委屈。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 동생이 도운 사실을 알기 전에도, 저는 제가 중심이라고 믿었습니다. 지금은 그 믿음이 흔들립니다.
en: Even before I knew my brother had helped, I believed I was the center. Now that belief is shaken.
ja: 弟が助けていた事実を知る前から、私は自分が中心だと信じていました。今はその信念が揺らいでいます。
zh-CN: 在知道弟弟帮忙之前，我就相信自己是中心。现在这个信念动摇了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 반쯤 따지고 반쯤 인정하는 표정이다.
en: His expression is half challenging, half admitting.
ja: 半分問い詰め、半分認める表情。
zh-CN: 表情一半质问，一半承认。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 더 받아야 한다는 마음이 없었다면 이렇게까지 분노하진 않았을 겁니다.
en: If I had not felt I should receive more, I would not have been this angry.
ja: 私がもっと受け取るべきだという気持ちがなければ、ここまで怒ることはなかったでしょう。
zh-CN: 如果我没有觉得自己应该多拿，就不会愤怒到这个程度。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 호흡을 고르고 자신의 마음을 다시 말한다.
en: Steadies his breath and states his feelings again.
ja: 呼吸を整え、自分の気持ちを改めて話す。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸，再次说出自己的心情。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 장남으로 산 시간이 제 권리라고 여긴 부분이 있습니다. 그걸 이제는 인정합니다.
en: There was a part of me that treated the years lived as eldest son as my right. I admit that now.
ja: 長男として生きた時間を自分の権利だと思っていた部分があります。今はそれを認めます。
zh-CN: 我有一部分把作为长子生活的时间当成自己的权利。现在我承认这一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 말이 책임을 없애진 않습니다. 다만 그때는 다른 길이 보이지 않았습니다.
en: Saying I tried to avoid the other side finding out does not erase responsibility. At the time, though, I saw no other path.
ja: 相手に知られるのを避けようとしたという言葉が責任を消すわけではありません。ただ、その時は他の道が見えませんでした。
zh-CN: 说我想避免对方知道，并不能消除责任。但当时我看不到别的路。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 문서를 바꾼 사람이라는 점은 인정합니다. 이유가 있어도 책임은 남습니다.
en: I admit that I am the one who changed the document. Even if there was a reason, the responsibility remains.
ja: 私が文書を変えた人間だという点は認めます。理由があっても責任は残ります。
zh-CN: 我承认自己是改动文件的人。即使有理由，责任仍然存在。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 그대로 두지 못한 점은 인정합니다. 하지만 그 이유가 제 이익만은 아니었습니다.
en: I admit I could not leave Mother's wishes as they were. But the reason was not only my own benefit.
ja: 母の意思をそのままにできなかった点は認めます。ただ、その理由が私の利益だけだったわけではありません。
zh-CN: 我承认自己没能让母亲的意愿保持原样。但理由并不只是我的利益。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 고친 책임을 피할 생각은 없습니다. 다만 그 선택의 배경도 함께 봐 주셨으면 합니다.
en: I do not intend to avoid responsibility for changing it. But I ask that the background of that choice be seen as well.
ja: 私が直した責任を避けるつもりはありません。ただ、その選択の背景もあわせて見てほしいです。
zh-CN: 我无意回避自己修改文件的责任。但也希望能一并看到那个选择的背景。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형을 위한다는 말로 모든 게 정리되지는 않는다는 걸 압니다.
en: Your Honor, I know that the words “for my brother” do not settle everything.
ja: 裁判官、兄のためという言葉だけですべてが整理されるわけではないと分かっています。
zh-CN: 法官，我知道“为了哥哥”这句话不能解释一切。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 문서에 제 손이 닿았습니다. 그 사실은 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 설명으로 지워지지 않습니다.
en: My hand touched that document. That fact is not erased by saying I tried to avoid the other side finding out.
ja: その文書に私の手が触れました。その事実は、相手に知られるのを避けようとしたという説明では消えません。
zh-CN: 那份文件上有我的手。这个事实不能被“我想避免对方知道”的说明抹去。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 건드린 건 무겁습니다. 저는 그 무게를 알면서도 당시엔 멈추지 못했습니다.
en: Touching Mother's wishes is serious. I knew that weight and still could not stop at the time.
ja: 母の意思に触れたことは重いです。その重さを知りながら、当時は止まれませんでした。
zh-CN: 动了母亲的意愿是很重的事。我知道这份重量，却当时还是没有停下。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책임이 없어지는 건 아닙니다. 저는 다만 더 큰 상처를 피한다고 믿었습니다.
en: Responsibility does not disappear. I only believed I was avoiding a greater wound.
ja: 責任がなくなるわけではありません。私はただ、もっと大きな傷を避けていると信じていました。
zh-CN: 责任不会消失。我只是相信自己是在避免更大的伤害。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 말은 제 동기일 뿐입니다. 결과의 책임까지 사라지는 건 아닙니다.
en: Saying I tried to avoid the other side finding out is only my motive. It does not erase responsibility for the result.
ja: 相手に知られるのを避けようとしたという言葉は、私の動機にすぎません。結果の責任まで消えるわけではありません。
zh-CN: 说我想避免对方知道，只是我的动机。它不能连结果责任也一起消除。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 선택이 옳았다고 단정하지 않겠습니다. 지금은 제가 한 일의 흠을 알고 있습니다.
en: I will not insist that choice was right. I now know the flaw in what I did.
ja: その選択が正しかったと断定しません。今は私がしたことの傷を分かっています。
zh-CN: 我不会断言那个选择是对的。现在我知道自己所做的事有伤痕。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 맞습니다. 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 이유가 어머니의 처음 적힌 비율 뜻을 고친 책임을 없애지 못합니다.
en: Yes. The reason of avoiding the other side finding out does not erase responsibility for changing the meaning of the ratio Mother first wrote.
ja: そのとおりです。相手に知られるのを避けようとした理由は、母が最初に書いた比率の意味を変えた責任を消しません。
zh-CN: 是的。避免对方知道这个理由，不能消除我改变母亲最初写下的比例含义的责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 이제는 인정합니다. 이유가 깊을수록 책임이 사라지는 게 아니라 더 분명해집니다.
en: I admit it now. The deeper the reason, the more clearly responsibility remains; it does not disappear.
ja: 今は認めます。理由が深いほど、責任は消えるのではなく、よりはっきりします。
zh-CN: 现在我承认。理由越深，责任不是消失，而是变得更加明确。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 제 출생과 관련한 민감한 사실을 감추려 어머니 뜻을 제 방식으로 처리했습니다. 그 책임은 전부 제게 있습니다.
en: Your Honor, I handled Mother's wishes in my own way to hide a sensitive fact tied to my birth. That responsibility is entirely mine.
ja: 裁判官、私は私の出生に関わる敏感な事実を隠すため、母の意思を自分のやり方で処理しました。その責任はすべて私にあります。
zh-CN: 法官，我为了隐藏与自己出生有关的敏感事实，用自己的方式处理了母亲的意愿。这个责任全在我。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 지키려 했다는 말로 위조를 덮을 수 없습니다. 저는 어머니의 마지막 뜻을 제 판단으로 다시 썼습니다.
en: Saying I tried to protect him cannot cover forgery. I rewrote Mother's final wishes by my own judgment.
ja: 守ろうとしたという言葉で偽造を覆うことはできません。私は母の最後の意思を自分の判断で書き直しました。
zh-CN: 说是为了保护他，不能遮盖伪造。我用自己的判断重写了母亲最后的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형이 무너질까 봐 두려웠다는 사실과 제가 문서를 고쳤다는 사실은 둘 다 진실입니다.
en: It is true that I feared my brother would collapse, and it is also true that I changed the document.
ja: 兄が崩れるのではないかと怖かった事実と、私が文書を変えた事実は、どちらも真実です。
zh-CN: 我害怕哥哥会崩溃，这是真的；我改了文件，也是真的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 선의를 이유로 남의 뜻을 손댔습니다. 그 선의가 저를 면책하지는 않습니다.
en: I touched someone else's wishes in the name of good faith. That good faith does not exempt me.
ja: 私は善意を理由に他人の意思に手を加えました。その善意は私を免責しません。
zh-CN: 我以善意为理由动了别人的意愿。那份善意不能让我免责。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니의 자필 연습본을 제 몫 90, 형 몫 10에서 제 몫 60, 형 몫 40으로 바꾼 사람은 저입니다. 형을 위한 선택이었다 해도 잘못입니다.
en: I am the one who changed Mother's handwritten draft from 90 for me and 10 for my brother to 60 for me and 40 for him. Even if it was for my brother, it was wrong.
ja: 母の自筆下書きを、私90・兄10から私60・兄40へ変えたのは私です。兄のための選択だったとしても、誤りです。
zh-CN: 把母亲亲笔草稿从我90、哥哥10改成我60、哥哥40的人是我。即使是为了哥哥，这也是错的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상대에게 알려지길 피하려다 형에게 필요한 진실도 늦췄고, 어머니 뜻도 훼손했습니다.
en: While trying to avoid the other side finding out, I delayed the truth my brother needed and damaged Mother's wishes.
ja: 相手に知られるのを避けようとして、兄に必要な真実も遅らせ、母の意思も損ないました。
zh-CN: 为了避免对方知道，我拖延了哥哥需要的真相，也损害了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 책임을 피하지 않겠습니다. 제가 지키려 한 선택은 법적으로도 관계적으로도 상처를 남겼습니다.
en: Your Honor, I will not avoid responsibility. The choice I made to protect him left wounds both legally and relationally.
ja: 裁判官、責任を避けません。私が守ろうとして選んだことは、法的にも関係的にも傷を残しました。
zh-CN: 法官，我不会逃避责任。我以保护为名作出的选择，在法律上和关系上都留下了伤害。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형 대신 판단했고 어머니 대신 문서를 고쳤습니다. 그 두 가지가 제 책임입니다.
en: I judged in my brother's place and changed the document in Mother's place. Those two things are my responsibility.
ja: 私は兄の代わりに判断し、母の代わりに文書を直しました。その二つが私の責任です。
zh-CN: 我替哥哥作了判断，也替母亲改了文件。这两件事就是我的责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자필 연습본을 제가 고쳐 쓴 책임은 제게 있습니다. 상대에게 알려지길 피하려 했다는 말은 변명이 될 수 없습니다.
en: The responsibility for rewriting the handwritten draft is mine. Saying I tried to avoid the other side finding out cannot be an excuse.
ja: 自筆下書きを私が書き換えた責任は私にあります。相手に知られるのを避けようとしたという言葉は言い訳にはなりません。
zh-CN: 改写亲笔草稿的责任在我。说我想避免对方知道，不能成为借口。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 책임을 줄이려고 설명하는 게 아닙니다. 책임이 왜 생겼는지 끝까지 말하는 겁니다.
en: I am not explaining to reduce responsibility. I am saying to the end why that responsibility arose.
ja: 責任を軽くするために説明しているのではありません。責任がなぜ生じたのかを最後まで話しているのです。
zh-CN: 我说明这些不是为了减轻责任，而是要把责任为何产生说到底。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니 뜻을 제가 조정했습니다. 지키겠다는 명분이 있었지만 그 명분이 절차를 대신하진 않습니다.
en: I adjusted Mother's wishes. I had the justification of protection, but that justification cannot replace procedure.
ja: 母の意思を私が調整しました。守るという名分はありましたが、その名分が手続きに代わることはありません。
zh-CN: 我调整了母亲的意愿。虽然有保护的名义，但这个名义不能代替程序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형이 무너질까 봐 숫자를 낮췄습니다. 그래도 어머니 뜻을 손댄 사람은 저입니다.
en: Your Honor, I lowered the numbers because I feared my brother would collapse. Still, the person who touched Mother's wishes is me.
ja: 裁判官、兄が崩れるのが怖くて数字を下げました。それでも、母の意思に手を加えた人間は私です。
zh-CN: 法官，我因为怕哥哥崩溃而降低了数字。即便如此，动了母亲意愿的人还是我。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 위해서였다는 설명은 가능합니다. 하지만 어머니가 남긴 뜻을 제가 고쳐 쓴 사실은 그대로입니다.
en: I can explain that it was for my brother. But the fact remains that I rewrote the wishes Mother left behind.
ja: 兄のためだったという説明は可能です。しかし、母が残した意思を私が書き換えた事実はそのままです。
zh-CN: 我可以说明那是为了哥哥。但母亲留下的意愿被我改写，这个事实仍然存在。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 선의를 앞세워 위법한 선택을 했습니다. 그 둘을 분리해서 보지 않겠습니다.
en: I made an unlawful choice in the name of good faith. I will not look at those two things as if they were separate.
ja: 私は善意を前に出して違法な選択をしました。その二つを切り離して見るつもりはありません。
zh-CN: 我打着善意作出了违法的选择。我不会把这两者分开来看。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형의 충격을 줄인다고 믿었지만, 어머니 의사까지 제가 줄여 버렸습니다.
en: I believed I was reducing my brother's shock, but I ended up reducing Mother's intent as well.
ja: 兄の衝撃を減らしていると信じていましたが、母の意思まで減らしてしまいました。
zh-CN: 我以为自己是在减轻哥哥的冲击，结果连母亲的意愿也一起削减了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 지키는 사람이 된 것처럼 굴었습니다. 그러나 어머니 뜻을 바꿀 권리는 없었습니다.
en: I acted as if I had become the protector. But I had no right to change Mother's wishes.
ja: 私は守る人になったかのように振る舞いました。しかし、母の意思を変える権利はありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我表现得像自己成了保护者。但我没有权利改变母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 책임은 돈 때문이 아니어도 남습니다. 오히려 제가 판단을 대신했다는 점이 더 큽니다.
en: That responsibility remains even if it was not about money. What is greater is that I judged in someone else's place.
ja: その責任は、金のためではなくても残ります。むしろ、私が代わりに判断した点のほうが大きいです。
zh-CN: 这个责任即使不是为了钱也仍然存在。更大的问题反而是我替别人作了判断。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
