notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 상대에게 알려지길 피하려는 이유가 있었습니다. 하지만 그 이유가 법과 어머니 뜻보다 위에 설 수는 없습니다.
en: There was a reason to avoid the other side finding out. But that reason cannot stand above the law or Mother's wishes.
ja: 相手に知られるのを避けたい理由はありました。しかし、その理由が法と母の意思の上に立つことはできません。
zh-CN: 确实有避免对方知道的理由。但这个理由不能站在法律和母亲意愿之上。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 대답 전 한 박자 멈추고 서류 끝을 본다.
en: Pauses one beat before answering and looks at the edge of the document.
ja: 答える前に一拍置き、書類の端を見る。
zh-CN: 回答前停顿一拍，看向文件边缘。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 말이 완전히 틀렸다고는 못 하겠습니다. 형도 저도 어머니 뜻을 자기 방식으로 붙잡았습니다.
en: I cannot say those words are completely wrong. Both my brother and I held Mother's wishes in our own ways.
ja: その言葉が完全に間違っているとは言えません。兄も私も、母の意思を自分のやり方で握りました。
zh-CN: 我不能说那句话完全错。哥哥和我都以自己的方式抓住了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 끝까지 담담하게 말하려 애쓴다.
en: Tries to speak calmly to the end.
ja: 最後まで淡々と話そうとする。
zh-CN: 努力平静地说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 그 말 앞에서 바로 반박하지 못하겠습니다. 저부터 어머니 뜻을 고친 사람이니까요.
en: I cannot immediately deny that. I am the one who altered Mother's wishes first.
ja: その言葉の前で、すぐ反論はできません。まず私が母の意思を変えた人間だからです。
zh-CN: 面对这句话，我无法立刻反驳。因为首先是我改动了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리로 인정 범위를 먼저 자른다.
en: In a low voice, first limits the scope of admission.
ja: 低い声で、まず認める範囲を切る。
zh-CN: 用低声先限定承认范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 어머니를 지킨다고 생각했지만, 사실은 제 판단을 앞세운 부분이 있습니다.
en: I thought I was protecting Mother, but in truth there were parts where I put my own judgment first.
ja: 私は母を守っていると思っていましたが、実際には自分の判断を前に出した部分があります。
zh-CN: 我以为自己是在保护母亲，但实际上有些部分是我把自己的判断放在了前面。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 시선을 오래 피하지 않지만 말끝은 닫는다.
en: Does not avoid the gaze for long, but closes off the ending.
ja: 長く視線を避けはしないが、語尾は閉じる。
zh-CN: 没有长久避开视线，但句尾收住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형은 형의 억울함으로, 저는 제 두려움으로 어머니 뜻을 다르게 읽었습니다.
en: My brother read Mother's wishes through his grievance, and I read them through my fear.
ja: 兄は兄の悔しさで、私は私の恐れで、母の意思を違うように読みました。
zh-CN: 哥哥用他的委屈，我用我的恐惧，以不同方式解读了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 손가락을 포개 쥔 채 조심스럽게 답한다.
en: Answers carefully with his fingers folded together.
ja: 指を重ねて握ったまま慎重に答える。
zh-CN: 手指交叠握着，小心回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 둘 다 어머니를 있는 그대로 두지 못했다는 말은 무겁지만 피하기 어렵습니다.
en: Your Honor, saying that neither of us left Mother as she was is heavy, but hard to avoid.
ja: 裁判官、二人とも母をありのままにはしておけなかったという言葉は重いですが、避けにくいです。
zh-CN: 法官，说我们两人都没能让母亲保持原样，这句话很重，但难以回避。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 숨을 고른 뒤 핵심 단어만 피해 간다.
en: Catches his breath, then avoids only the key word.
ja: 息を整えた後、核心の言葉だけを避ける。
zh-CN: 调整呼吸后，只避开核心词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형을 막으려 했고 형은 자기 몫을 붙잡았습니다. 그 사이에서 어머니 뜻이 흔들렸습니다.
en: I tried to block my brother, and my brother clung to his share. Between us, Mother's wishes were shaken.
ja: 私は兄を止めようとし、兄は自分の取り分を握りました。その間で母の意思が揺れました。
zh-CN: 我试图挡住哥哥，哥哥则抓住自己的份额。在我们之间，母亲的意愿被动摇了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 턱이 굳지만 목소리는 평평하게 유지한다.
en: His jaw tightens, but his voice stays even.
ja: 顎はこわばるが、声は平らに保つ。
zh-CN: 下颌绷紧，但声音保持平稳。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 모든 책임을 혼자 진다고 해도 형의 당연시가 사라지는 건 아닙니다.
en: Even if I take all responsibility alone, my brother's assumption of entitlement does not disappear.
ja: 私がすべての責任を一人で負うとしても、兄の当然視が消えるわけではありません。
zh-CN: 即使我一个人承担所有责任，哥哥的理所当然也不会消失。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 고개를 끄덕이고 다시 선을 긋는다.
en: Gives a small nod and draws the line again.
ja: 短くうなずき、また線を引く。
zh-CN: 短促点头后，再次划清界线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형도 상처가 있었고 저도 두려움이 있었습니다. 둘 다 그 감정으로 어머니를 보았습니다.
en: My brother had hurt, and I had fear. Both of us looked at Mother through those feelings.
ja: 兄には傷があり、私には恐れがありました。二人ともその感情で母を見ました。
zh-CN: 哥哥有伤，我有恐惧。我们都透过这些情绪看母亲。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 입술을 누른 뒤 필요한 사실만 꺼낸다.
en: Presses his lips, then gives only the necessary facts.
ja: 唇を押さえた後、必要な事実だけを出す。
zh-CN: 抿住嘴唇后，只说必要事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 아직 한 문장으로 정리하긴 어렵지만, 어머니 뜻을 있는 그대로 둔 사람은 없었습니다.
en: It is still hard to put in one sentence, but no one left Mother's wishes untouched.
ja: まだ一文で整理するのは難しいですが、母の意思をそのままにした人はいませんでした。
zh-CN: 现在还很难用一句话整理，但没有人让母亲的意愿保持原样。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정은 누르고 문장 사이를 길게 둔다.
en: Suppresses emotion and leaves long gaps between sentences.
ja: 感情を抑え、文と文の間を長く取る。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，在句子之间留出长停顿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 지키려 했다고 말했고 형은 돌봤다고 말했습니다. 둘 다 어머니를 자기 말 안에 넣었습니다.
en: I said I was protecting her, and my brother said he cared for her. Both of us put Mother inside our own words.
ja: 私は守ろうとしたと言い、兄は介護したと言いました。二人とも母を自分の言葉の中に入れました。
zh-CN: 我说自己是在保护，哥哥说自己照顾过。我们两人都把母亲放进了自己的话里。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 눈을 한 번 감았다 뜨고 낮게 고백한다.
en: Closes his eyes once, opens them, and confesses quietly.
ja: 一度目を閉じて開き、低く告白する。
zh-CN: 闭眼又睁开，低声坦白。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 인정합니다. 형도 저도 어머니를 있는 그대로 두지 못했고, 어머니 뜻은 우리 손에서 두 번 왜곡됐습니다.
en: I admit it. Neither my brother nor I left Mother as she was, and Mother's wishes were distorted twice in our hands.
ja: 認めます。兄も私も母をありのままにはしておけず、母の意思は私たちの手で二度ゆがみました。
zh-CN: 我承认。哥哥和我都没能让母亲保持原样，母亲的意愿在我们手中被扭曲了两次。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 고개를 숙인 채 변명보다 책임을 앞세운다.
en: With head lowered, puts responsibility before excuses.
ja: 頭を下げたまま、言い訳より責任を先に出す。
zh-CN: 低着头，把责任放在辩解之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 이제는 인정하겠습니다. 우리 둘 모두 어머니의 마지막 뜻보다 각자의 두려움을 먼저 붙잡았습니다.
en: I will admit it now. Both of us held on to our own fears before Mother's final wishes.
ja: 今は認めます。私たち二人とも、母の最後の意思より各自の恐れを先につかみました。
zh-CN: 现在我承认。我们两个人都把各自的恐惧放在了母亲最后的意愿之前。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 목소리가 마지막 문장에서 미세하게 갈라진다.
en: His voice cracks faintly in the final sentence.
ja: 最後の文で声がかすかに割れる。
zh-CN: 声音在最后一句微微发颤。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형은 장남의 권리로 어머니를 읽었고 저는 지키겠다는 명분으로 어머니 뜻을 고쳤습니다.
en: Your Honor, my brother read Mother through the right of eldest son, and I changed Mother's wishes under the excuse of protection.
ja: 裁判官、兄は長男の権利で母を読み、私は守るという名分で母の意思を変えました。
zh-CN: 法官，哥哥用长子的权利解读母亲，而我以保护为名改变了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 담담한 표정이 무너지지 않지만 숨이 길어진다.
en: His calm expression does not break, but his breathing lengthens.
ja: 淡々とした表情は崩れないが、息が長くなる。
zh-CN: 平静表情没有崩塌，但呼吸变长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 둘 다 어머니를 사랑한다고 말했지만, 결국 각자의 두려움을 어머니 뜻 위에 올렸습니다.
en: We both said we loved Mother, but in the end we placed our own fears on top of her wishes.
ja: 二人とも母を愛していると言いましたが、結局それぞれの恐れを母の意思の上に置きました。
zh-CN: 我们都说爱母亲，但最终都把各自的恐惧放到了母亲意愿之上。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 더 숨기지 않겠다는 듯 문장을 끝까지 잇는다.
en: Carries the sentence to the end as if he will hide no more.
ja: これ以上隠さないというように、文を最後までつなぐ。
zh-CN: 像是不再隐瞒一样，把句子说到最后。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 형을 지킨다는 말로 어머니의 처음 적힌 비율을 바꿨고, 형은 돌봄의 시간으로 더 받을 권리를 믿었습니다.
en: I changed Mother's first written ratio in the name of protecting my brother, and my brother believed his years of care entitled him to more.
ja: 私は兄を守るという言葉で母が最初に書いた比率を変え、兄は介護した時間でより受け取る権利を信じました。
zh-CN: 我以保护哥哥为名改变了母亲最初写下的比例，哥哥则因为照顾的时间相信自己有权多拿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보지 못한 채 책임을 인정한다.
en: Admits responsibility without being able to look toward his brother.
ja: 兄の方を見られないまま責任を認める。
zh-CN: 无法看向哥哥，却承认责任。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 이 사건은 누가 더 나쁜가만의 문제가 아닙니다. 둘 다 어머니 뜻을 자기 방식으로 다룬 문제입니다.
en: This case is not only about who was worse. It is about both of us handling Mother's wishes in our own ways.
ja: この事件は、誰がより悪いかだけの問題ではありません。二人とも母の意思を自分のやり方で扱った問題です。
zh-CN: 这起案件不只是看谁更坏。问题在于我们两人都以自己的方式处理了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류에서 손을 떼고 재판관을 똑바로 본다.
en: Takes his hands off the document and looks straight at the Judge.
ja: 書類から手を離し、裁判官をまっすぐ見る。
zh-CN: 把手从文件上移开，直视法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 어머니 뜻을 법적으로 훼손했고, 형은 그 뜻을 자기 상처의 기준으로만 봤습니다.
en: I damaged Mother's wishes legally, and my brother saw those wishes only through the standard of his own hurt.
ja: 私は母の意思を法的に損ない、兄はその意思を自分の傷の基準でだけ見ました。
zh-CN: 我在法律上损害了母亲的意愿，哥哥则只用自己受伤的标准来看待那份意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 오래 참은 말을 한꺼번에 꺼내듯 이어 간다.
en: Continues as if releasing words long held back.
ja: 長くこらえていた言葉を一気に出すように続ける。
zh-CN: 像一下说出压抑已久的话一样继续。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 제가 한 일은 명확한 잘못이고, 형의 마음도 어머니 뜻을 있는 그대로 보지 못했습니다.
en: Your Honor, what I did is clearly wrong, and my brother's heart also failed to see Mother's wishes as they were.
ja: 裁判官、私がしたことは明確な誤りであり、兄の心も母の意思をありのまま見ることができませんでした。
zh-CN: 法官，我做的事是明确的错误，哥哥的心也没能如实看见母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말끝이 낮아지지만 핵심은 흐리지 않는다.
en: His ending falls low, but the core does not blur.
ja: 語尾は低くなるが、核心はぼかさない。
zh-CN: 句尾低下，但核心不模糊。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 남긴 말은 우리 둘 사이에서 증거와 방패가 됐습니다. 그게 가장 아픈 부분입니다.
en: Mother's words became both evidence and a shield between us. That is the most painful part.
ja: 母が残した言葉は、私たちの間で証拠にも盾にもなりました。それが一番痛い部分です。
zh-CN: 母亲留下的话在我们之间既成了证据，也成了盾牌。这是最痛的部分。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 침묵 뒤에 가장 무거운 사실을 놓는다.
en: After a silence, places the heaviest fact on the record.
ja: 沈黙の後、最も重い事実を置く。
zh-CN: 沉默之后说出最沉重的事实。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형을 탓하며 숨고 싶지 않습니다. 저도 어머니를 지킨다는 명분 안에 가둔 사람입니다.
en: I do not want to hide behind blaming my brother. I am also someone who trapped Mother inside the excuse of protection.
ja: 兄を責めて隠れたいとは思いません。私も母を守るという名分の中に閉じ込めた人間です。
zh-CN: 我不想躲在责怪哥哥后面。我也是把母亲困在保护名义里的人。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르다 한 번 숨을 길게 내쉰다.
en: Chooses his words, then lets out one long breath.
ja: 言葉を選び、一度長く息を吐く。
zh-CN: 斟酌措辞后长长呼出一口气。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 인정합니다. 형은 장남이라는 마음으로, 저는 지키겠다는 명분으로 어머니 뜻을 각자 비틀었습니다.
en: I admit it. My brother twisted Mother's wishes through the heart of eldest son, and I twisted them through the excuse of protection.
ja: 認めます。兄は長男という心で、私は守るという名分で、母の意思をそれぞれねじ曲げました。
zh-CN: 我承认。哥哥以长子的心态，我以保护的名义，各自扭曲了母亲的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 흔들림을 숨기려 자세를 곧게 세운다.
en: Straightens his posture to hide his wavering.
ja: 揺らぎを隠すように姿勢を正す。
zh-CN: 挺直姿势，试图掩饰动摇。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니를 지킨다고 말했지만, 사실 저는 어머니 뜻을 제가 감당할 수 있는 형태로 고쳤습니다.
en: I said I was protecting Mother, but in truth I changed her wishes into a form I could bear.
ja: 母を守ると言いましたが、実際には母の意思を私が耐えられる形に変えました。
zh-CN: 我说是在保护母亲，但实际上是把母亲的意愿改成了我能承受的形式。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책상 모서리를 천천히 문지르며 답한다.
en: Answers while slowly rubbing the edge of the desk.
ja: 机の角をゆっくりなでながら答える。
zh-CN: 一边慢慢摩挲桌角一边回答。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형만 어머니를 이용한 것도 아니고 저만 희생한 것도 아닙니다. 둘 다 자기 방식으로 붙잡았습니다.
en: It was not only my brother who used Mother, and it was not only I who sacrificed. We both held on in our own ways.
ja: 兄だけが母を利用したわけでも、私だけが犠牲になったわけでもありません。二人とも自分のやり方で握りました。
zh-CN: 不是只有哥哥利用了母亲，也不是只有我作了牺牲。我们都用自己的方式抓住了她。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 핵심에 이르면 시선을 피하지 않는다.
en: Does not avert his eyes when he reaches the key point.
ja: 核心に至ると視線をそらさない。
zh-CN: 说到核心时不回避视线。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 형은 몫을 당연시했고 저는 뜻을 고쳤습니다. 어느 쪽도 온전하지 않았습니다.
en: Your Honor, my brother took his share for granted, and I changed the wishes. Neither side was whole.
ja: 裁判官、兄は取り分を当然視し、私は意思を変えました。どちらも完全ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 法官，哥哥把份额当成理所当然，我则改动了意愿。哪一边都不完整。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 낮은 목소리지만 인정 대목은 또렷하다.
en: His voice is low, but the admission is clear.
ja: 低い声だが、認める部分ははっきりしている。
zh-CN: 声音很低，但承认的部分很清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 저는 선의를 말하지만 결과적으로 어머니 뜻을 제 손으로 배치했습니다. 형도 자기 상처로 그 뜻을 읽었습니다.
en: I speak of good faith, but in the result I arranged Mother's wishes with my own hands. My brother also read those wishes through his hurt.
ja: 私は善意を語りますが、結果的に母の意思を自分の手で配置しました。兄も自分の傷でその意思を読みました。
zh-CN: 我说的是善意，但结果上是我亲手安排了母亲的意愿。哥哥也用自己的伤来读那份意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 짧게 끊어 말하다가 이유에서 길어진다.
en: Speaks in short fragments, then lengthens when giving the reason.
ja: 短く切って話し、理由のところで長くなる。
zh-CN: 说话短促，到理由处变得更长。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 둘 다 어머니를 사랑했다고 말할 수는 있습니다. 하지만 사랑이 뜻을 대신할 수는 없습니다.
en: We may both say we loved Mother. But love cannot replace her wishes.
ja: 二人とも母を愛していたと言うことはできます。しかし、愛が意思の代わりになることはありません。
zh-CN: 我们两人都可以说爱母亲。但爱不能代替她的意愿。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형 쪽을 보려다 다시 재판관을 본다.
en: Starts to look toward his brother, then looks back at the Judge.
ja: 兄の方を見ようとして、また裁判官を見る。
zh-CN: 想看向哥哥，又重新看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형은 어머니를 자기 수고의 증거로 봤고, 저는 어머니를 형을 지키는 이유로 삼았습니다.
en: My brother saw Mother as proof of his labor, and I used Mother as the reason to protect my brother.
ja: 兄は母を自分の苦労の証拠として見て、私は母を兄を守る理由にしました。
zh-CN: 哥哥把母亲看成自己辛苦的证明，而我把母亲当成保护哥哥的理由。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 감정을 눌러 두며 책임 단어를 피하지 않는다.
en: Keeps emotion down and does not avoid the word responsibility.
ja: 感情を抑えながら、責任という言葉を避けない。
zh-CN: 压住情绪，不回避“责任”这个词。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머니가 남긴 마음은 두 사람의 두려움과 자존심 사이에서 바뀌었습니다.
en: Mother's remaining heart changed between two people's fear and pride.
ja: 母が残した心は、二人の恐れと自尊心の間で変わりました。
zh-CN: 母亲留下的心意在两个人的恐惧和自尊之间被改变了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문장 끝마다 잠깐 멈추며 범위를 조정한다.
en: Pauses at the end of each sentence to adjust the scope.
ja: 文末ごとに少し止まり、範囲を調整する。
zh-CN: 每句话末尾短暂停顿，调整范围。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 형을 탓하기만 할 수 없는 이유가 여기에 있습니다. 저도 어머니 뜻을 그대로 두지 못했습니다.
en: This is why I cannot only blame my brother. I also failed to leave Mother's wishes as they were.
ja: 私が兄を責めるだけではいられない理由はここにあります。私も母の意思をそのままにできませんでした。
zh-CN: 这就是我不能只责怪哥哥的原因。我也没能让母亲的意愿保持原样。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기록을 떠올리듯 날짜 대신 순서를 짚는다.
en: Traces the sequence rather than dates, as if recalling the record.
ja: 記録を思い出すように、日付ではなく順序をたどる。
zh-CN: 像回忆记录一样，不说日期而是梳理顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 형의 당연시와 제 조작이 서로 다른 방식으로 같은 결과를 냈습니다.
en: My brother's entitlement and my manipulation led to the same result in different ways.
ja: 兄の当然視と私の操作は、違う方法で同じ結果を生みました。
zh-CN: 哥哥的理所当然和我的操纵，以不同方式造成了同一个结果。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관이 책임 회피를 끊고 핵심 답변을 요구한다. 모순을 법정 기록으로 고정하는 톤이다.
en: The Judge cuts off avoidance of responsibility and demands a key answer. Tone fixes the contradiction in the court record.
ja: 裁判官が責任回避を断ち切り、核心の答えを求める。矛盾を法廷記録に固定するトーン。
zh-CN: 法官切断逃避责任，要求核心回答。语气将矛盾固定为法庭记录。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 윤정후 씨, 방문과 낭독을 인정하면서 개입 책임만 피하고 있습니다. 지금 선을 명확히 하십시오.
en: Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu, you acknowledge the visit and the reading, yet avoid only the responsibility for intervening. Draw the line clearly now.
ja: ユン・ジョンフさん、訪問と読み上げは認めながら、介入の責任だけを避けています。今、その線を明確にしてください。
zh-CN: 尹正厚先生，您承认探望和朗读，却只避开介入责任。现在请把界线说清楚。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관이 책임 회피를 끊고 핵심 답변을 요구한다. 모순을 법정 기록으로 고정하는 톤이다.
en: The Judge cuts off avoidance of responsibility and demands a key answer. Tone fixes the contradiction in the court record.
ja: 裁判官が責任回避を断ち切り、核心の答えを求める。矛盾を法廷記録に固定するトーン。
zh-CN: 法官切断逃避责任，要求核心回答。语气将矛盾固定为法庭记录。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 윤태성 씨, 어머니 상태를 단정했다가 일부 가능성을 인정했습니다. 왜 그렇게 밀어붙였습니까.
en: Mr. Yoon Tae-seong, you were certain about Mother's condition, then admitted some possibility. Why did you push it that far?
ja: ユン・テソンさん、母の状態を断定しておきながら、一部の可能性は認めました。なぜそこまで押し通したのですか。
zh-CN: 尹泰成先生，您先断定母亲的状态，随后又承认部分可能性。为什么要那样强推？
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관이 책임 회피를 끊고 핵심 답변을 요구한다. 모순을 법정 기록으로 고정하는 톤이다.
en: The Judge cuts off avoidance of responsibility and demands a key answer. Tone fixes the contradiction in the court record.
ja: 裁判官が責任回避を断ち切り、核心の答えを求める。矛盾を法廷記録に固定するトーン。
